zh: 隔离桩：广场没有临路边缘。

en: Each lawn becomes one collection: flower beds, shrubs, an arboretum or meadow.
zh: 每块草坪形成一个植物展区：花坛、灌木、树木园或草甸。

en: Round and long beds of massed flowers, edged with low shrubs, beside the walks.
zh: 步道旁密植花卉的圆形和长条形花坛，以低矮灌木镶边。

en: Share of the shrubs planted as borders along the walks; the rest stand in clumps on the lawns.
zh: 沿步道作为边界种植的灌木比例；其余灌木在草坪上成丛分布。

en: Planting per hectare in the collections.
zh: 植物展区内每公顷的种植数量。

en: A glasshouse (or shelter) beside the main path.
zh: 主步道旁的温室（或遮雨棚）。
仅能容纳 {1} 个设施中的 {0} 个。

en: One run, or separate runs for big and small dogs.
zh: 一个活动区，或分别为大型犬和小型犬设置独立活动区。

en: Jumps, tunnels and weave poles in the big run.
zh: 大型犬活动区中的跳跃栏、隧道和绕杆。

en: A small fenced entry pen at each gate so dogs cannot slip out.
zh: 每个入口设置小型围栏缓冲区，防止犬只溜出。

en: A dog bin by each gate and a drinking post.
zh: 每个入口旁设置宠物粪便箱和饮水柱。
每个野餐点的桌子数量。

en: A grill or fire pit at each picnic spot.
zh: 每个野餐点设置烧烤架或火塘。

en: Share of the area kept as an open lawn in the middle.
zh: 区域中央保留为开阔草坪的面积比例。

en: One restroom per 1.5 ha beside the paths.
zh: 步道旁每 1.5 公顷设置一间厕所。

en: Open meadows in the woods, each with a bench.
zh: 林中的开阔草甸，每处设有长椅。

en: A lookout tower (or shelter) beside the trail at the highest point.
zh: 最高点的小径旁设置瞭望塔（或遮雨棚）。
绘制林地地面（永久生效）。
每块花坛周围的低矮绿篱。

en: Rows of trees along the main axis.
No room for symmetric parterres in this outline.
zh: 此轮廓内没有空间布置对称模纹花坛。

en: A shed on every plot, shared sheds, or none.
zh: 每块地设置工具棚、共用工具棚，或不设置。

en: A shelter with tables and a water tank by the entrance.
zh: 入口旁带桌子和水箱的遮雨棚。

en: No plots fit: try smaller plots.
zh: 无法容纳地块：请尝试缩小地块。

en: Stalls on a square of 0.4 ha. A bigger square gets more, in proportion (up to four times as many), so the market fills it.
zh: 0.4 公顷广场上的摊位数量。更大的广场会按比例增加摊位（最多四倍），使集市充满广场。

en: Width of the aisles between the stall rows.
zh: 摊位行列之间通道的宽度。

en: Trees just inside the edge with benches between them.
zh: 边缘内侧的树木，树间设有长椅。

en: The market fills the whole area, whatever its shape: a tree-lined market street between your entrances, a fountain where it meets the cross street, side streets, food courts at the crossings, planting islands and café groves in the blocks, and stalls right up to the edge.
zh: 集市会填满整个区域，适应任意形状：两个入口之间为林荫集市街，与横街交汇处设置喷泉，同时布置支路、路口美食区、街区内的绿化岛和林间咖啡区，以及延伸至边缘的摊位。

en: Bollards along the road edges (Big market: across each entrance, so people walk in and cars stay out).
zh: 沿道路边缘设置隔离桩（大型集市：横跨各个入口，让行人进入并阻挡汽车）。

en: Click the edge where you want a way in, as in the parking tool. Nothing is added for you: the market is built only once you have placed at least one entrance. The market street runs between your two main entrances.
zh: 像停车场工具一样，点击边缘上希望设置出入口的位置。不会自动添加入口：至少放置一个入口后才会建造集市。集市街连接两个主要入口。

en: A way in for people: the walk in, bollards across it, bike racks and a food cart beside it.
zh: 行人入口：进入集市的步道、横向隔离桩，以及旁边的自行车架和餐车。

en: A small car park at this edge of the market, cars in and out here. People walk from it into the market.
zh: 在集市此侧边缘设置小型停车场，车辆在此进出。行人从停车场步行进入集市。

en: A car park entered here. Put a way out next to it; on its own it is made two-way.
zh: 停车场车辆从此进入。请在旁边放置出口；若单独放置则设为双向。

en: A car park left here. Put a way in next to it; on its own it is made two-way.
zh: 停车场车辆从此驶出。请在旁边放置入口；若单独放置则设为双向。

en: A service lane for the stall vans: a small pedestrian street from a new junction on the street a short way into the market.
zh: 供摊贩货车使用的服务通道：从街道新建路口向集市内部延伸一小段的步行街。

en: A service lane for the stall vans (pedestrian streets are two-way, so it is the same as a driveway).
zh: 供摊贩货车使用的服务通道（步行街为双向，因此与车行通道相同）。

en: Place at least one entrance on the edge: a gate for people, a car entrance or a driveway. Nothing is built until you do.
zh: 至少在边缘放置一个入口：行人大门、车辆入口或车行通道。放置后才会开始建造。

en: Bare soil in the tree pits, lawn in the planting islands and worn ground where the gates meet the street (terrain paint: it stays after the market is removed).
zh: 树池中的裸土、绿化岛内的草坪，以及入口与街道交接处的踩损地面（地形绘制：移除集市后仍会保留）。
仅能容纳 {1} 个摊位中的 {0} 个。

en: A car entrance could not get a car park (no street in front of it, or no room there).
zh: 某个车辆入口无法生成停车场（前方没有街道，或此处空间不足）。

en: A driveway needs a street in front of it and room behind it; this one was left out.
zh: 车行通道前方需要街道，后方需要足够空间；此通道已省略。

en: How much of the area is the skate surface.
zh: 区域中滑板场地所占的比例。

en: A memorial or chapel near the crossing of the main paths.
zh: 主步道交汇处附近的纪念设施或礼拜堂。

en: Distance between rest stops (benches, bin, tree).
zh: 休息站的间距（长椅、垃圾桶、树木）。

en: A narrow parallel path where the strip is wide enough.
zh: 在绿带足够宽的位置设置一条较窄的平行步道。

en: Winding paths through themed collections: flower beds, shrubs, arboretum, meadow, and a glasshouse.
zh: 蜿蜒步道穿过花坛、灌木、树木园、草甸和温室等主题展区。

en: A designed sports park: one main field with a spectator terrace and clubhouse, courts clustered by sport, a promenade loop, groves and berms between the zones.
zh: 精心规划的体育公园：主运动场配有观众平台和会所，球场按运动类型集中布置，区间设有环形散步道、树丛和土堤。

en: Fenced runs with double gates, an agility course, benches and dog bins.
zh: 带双重门的围栏活动区，配有敏捷训练场、长椅和宠物粪便箱。

en: Picnic spots with tables and grills round an open lawn, shelters and restrooms.
zh: 野餐点围绕开阔草坪布置，配有桌子、烧烤架、遮雨棚和厕所。

en: Dense woodland with narrow trails, clearings and a lookout.
zh: 茂密林地，配有狭窄小径、林间空地和瞭望点。

en: Symmetric parterres with hedges, axes, allées and a fountain.
zh: 对称模纹花坛，配有绿篱、轴线、林荫道和喷泉。

en: Allotment plots with crops and sheds along lanes, and a communal hub.
zh: 沿小路布置种有作物、配有工具棚的菜园地块，并设置公共中心。

en: A paved square with market stalls, a tree ring and a centrepiece.
zh: 带集市摊位、环形树带和中心装饰的铺装广场。

en: A skate area with ramps, benches round it and graffiti.
zh: 配有坡台、周边长椅及涂鸦的滑板区。

en: Grave sections in rows with hedges, straight paths and a memorial.
zh: 成排墓区，配有绿篱、笔直步道和纪念设施。

en: A linear park: a long walk with planting and rest stops.
zh: 线性公园：设有绿化和休息站的长步道。

en: A storage and loading yard laid out like a parking lot: container stacks, pallets, crates or lumber in blocks between drive aisles, truck loading bays, sheds and floodlights.
zh: 按停车场形式布局的仓储装卸场：车行通道间的区块存放集装箱堆、托盘、货箱或木材，并配有货车装卸位、仓棚和泛光灯。

en: What fills the storage blocks. Mixed varies the goods from block to block.
zh: 仓储区块内存放的物品。混合模式会让各区块存放不同货物。

en: Width of the drive aisles between the storage blocks (forklifts need 4 m, trucks 8 m or more).
zh: 仓储区块之间车行通道的宽度（叉车需要 4 m，货车需要 8 m 或以上）。

en: Depth of each storage block between two aisles. Deeper blocks hold more rows.
zh: 两条通道之间每个仓储区块的深度。较深的区块可容纳更多排货物。

en: Length of a storage block before the next cross aisle.
zh: 两个横向通道之间仓储区块的长度。

en: Share of the storage slots that hold goods. Lower looks like a yard mid-shift.
zh: 存有货物的货位比例。较低时看起来像正在作业的堆场。

en: Rotates the aisle grid against the area's long axis.
zh: 相对于区域长轴旋转通道网格。

en: Where the truck loading bays go: the edge far from the entrance (back), near it (front), two edges, or none.
zh: 货车装卸位的位置：远离入口的边缘（后方）、靠近入口的边缘（前方）、两个边缘，或不设置。

en: Share of the loading bays with a truck or trailer backed in.
zh: 停有倒车入位的货车或挂车的装卸位比例。

en: Warehouse sheds or lean-tos along the edge behind the loading bays.
zh: 沿装卸位后方边缘设置仓库棚或简易棚。

en: Forklifts, reach stackers and yard tractors per hectare, working the aisles.
zh: 每公顷在通道内作业的叉车、集装箱正面吊和场内牵引车数量。

en: A guard booth and boom barrier at the main entrance.
zh: 主入口处的岗亭和道闸。

en: A site office cabin next to the entrance lane.
zh: 入口车道旁的现场办公房。

en: Painted aisle lines, block outlines and bay lines (hard ground only).
zh: 绘制通道线、区块轮廓和装卸位标线（仅限硬质地面）。

en: Oil, dirt and puddle decals per 100 m², in clumps.
zh: 每 100 m² 成簇分布的油污、泥污和水洼贴花数量。

en: Levels the yard so stacks stand flat, blended back to the ground at the outline (permanent).
zh: 整平堆场，使堆垛平稳放置，并在边界处平滑衔接原地形（永久生效）。

en: A planted strip of this width between the outline and the yard.
zh: 在轮廓与堆场之间设置此宽度的绿化带。

en: Logistics yard: the area is too narrow for the green buffer; the yard fills it all.
zh: 物流堆场：区域太窄，无法容纳绿化缓冲带；堆场将占满整个区域。

en: A cabin or shed for the yard crew.
zh: 供堆场员工使用的活动房或棚屋。

en: A big landscaped hill blended into the ground, a spiral or switchback path to a summit viewpoint; or a sledding hill, viewpoint mound, observation terraces or kite hill.
zh: 与地面平滑融合的大型景观山丘，螺旋或折返步道通往山顶观景点；也可生成雪橇山丘、观景土丘、阶梯观景台或风筝山丘。

en: Hilltop lookout, sledding hill (open run, straw bales), small viewpoint mound, stepped observation terraces or an open kite hill.
zh: 山顶观景点、雪橇山丘（开阔滑道、草捆）、小型观景土丘、阶梯观景台或开阔风筝山丘。

en: Height of the summit above the original ground. A small area cannot hold a tall hill at a walkable slope; the summary says when it came out lower.
zh: 山顶高于原始地面的高度。小区域无法在保持适宜步行坡度的同时容纳高山丘；若实际高度降低，摘要中会说明。

en: Mound: rounded foot and top. Cone: straight slopes. Dome: steep foot, round top. Mesa: broad flat top. Terraced: stepped levels.
zh: 土丘：坡脚和顶部圆润。圆锥：笔直坡面。穹顶：坡脚陡、顶部圆。平顶山：宽阔平顶。台地：阶梯层级。

en: Centre: the middle of the area. Far: away from the entrance (long slope towards it). Highest: on the highest existing ground.
zh: 中央：区域中心。远端：远离入口（长坡面朝向入口）。最高处：位于现有地形最高点。

en: Radius of the flat top where the viewpoint plaza sits.
zh: 观景广场所在平顶的半径。

en: Steepest slope of the hill. Near the outline it always blends gently back to the original ground.
zh: 山丘最陡坡度。靠近轮廓处始终柔和衔接原地形。

en: Natural bumps and hollows on the slopes.
zh: 坡面上的自然隆起和凹陷。

en: Spiral: winds round the hill at an even grade. Switchback: zig-zags up one side. Direct: straight up where it is gentle. None: no path.
zh: 螺旋：以均匀坡度绕山攀升。折返：沿一侧之字形上行。直达：在平缓处直接上行。无：不设步道。

en: How steeply the path climbs. 5 to 8 % is accessible, 12 % and more is a hiking trail.
zh: 步道上坡的陡峭程度。5% 至 8% 便于通行，12% 及以上适合徒步小径。

en: Benches spread along the way up.
zh: 沿上山路线分散设置的长椅。

en: What crowns the summit plaza: a lookout tower, a pavilion, a cairn or monument, just the plaza, or nothing.
zh: 山顶广场上的设施：瞭望塔、亭子、石堆或纪念碑、仅广场，或不放置任何设施。

en: Coin telescopes on the summit rim, looking out.
zh: 山顶边缘朝外的投币式望远镜。

en: Paints worn ground round the summit (permanent).
zh: 在山顶周围绘制踩损地面（永久生效）。

en: Trees on the slopes below the tree line.
zh: 林线以下坡面上的树木。

en: Trees only grow below this share of the hill height, so the top stays open for the view.
zh: 树木只在此山丘高度比例以下生长，让山顶保持开阔视野。

en: Width of the open sledding run down the longest slope. Kept free of trees and paths.
zh: 沿最长坡面向下延伸的开阔雪橇滑道宽度。滑道内不放树木和步道。

en: Straw bales (or a fence) across the bottom of the run.
zh: 横放在滑道底部的草捆（或围栏）。

en: Kites and windsocks on the open upper slopes.
zh: 开阔上部坡面上的风筝和风向袋。

en: The hill reaches {0} m instead of {1} m: the area is too small for that height at this slope.
zh: 山丘高度为 {0} m，未达到 {1} m：在当前坡度下，区域太小，无法达到目标高度。

en: The path could not reach the summit at this grade; try a steeper grade or the switchback style.
zh: 步道无法以此坡度到达山顶；请尝试增大坡度或使用折返风格。

en: No slope is long enough for a sledding run.
zh: 没有足够长的坡面可用作雪橇滑道。

en: Benches with telescopes and information boards on the summit rim.
zh: 山顶边缘配有望远镜和信息板的长椅。

en: A coin telescope beside each bench.
zh: 每张长椅旁的一台投币式望远镜。

en: A panorama / information board behind each bench.
zh: 每张长椅后方的全景介绍／信息板。

en: An axial procession to a focal monument, a reflecting pool, hedged garden rooms and quiet lighting.
zh: 沿轴线布置的纪念大道通往中心纪念碑，配有倒影池、绿篱围合庭园及柔和照明。

en: Sets the character: garden, paved square, war memorial, reflection garden or a sculpture park with a trail instead of an axis.
zh: 设定风格：花园、铺装广场、战争纪念地、静思花园，或以小径代替轴线的雕塑公园。

en: The monument closes the axis at the far end, or stands in the centre with the axis running on.
zh: 纪念碑位于轴线远端作为终点，或位于中央，让轴线继续延伸。

en: Width of the processional way (8 m and more uses a wide path; the paved strip follows it when Paved procession is on).
zh: 纪念大道的宽度（8 m 及以上采用宽步道；开启铺装纪念大道后，铺装带会沿其延伸）。

en: A second path crossing the main axis at the monument.
zh: 在纪念碑处与主轴交叉的第二条步道。

en: Lays a paved strip under the procession path and small pads under the trail sculptures. The walks themselves are always paths.
zh: 在纪念大道下方铺设铺装带，在小径雕塑下方铺设小平台。步行通道本身始终使用步道。

en: Radius (half-width for square courts) of the paved forecourt round the monument.
zh: 纪念碑周围铺装前庭的半径（方形前庭为半宽）。

en: Raises the forecourt on a mound blended back to the ground (permanent terrain change).
zh: 在与地面平滑衔接的土丘上抬高前庭（永久改变地形）。

en: Plaques or wreaths in an arc before the monument (memorial stones when none are installed).
zh: 在纪念碑前以弧形布置纪念牌或花圈（未安装相关资产时使用纪念石）。

en: Sculptures on pads beside the trail (sculpture park).
zh: 小径旁平台上的雕塑（雕塑公园）。

en: A long pool on the axis; the walk splits round it.
zh: 轴线上的长条水池；步道分为两路绕行。

en: Share of the procession the pool takes.
zh: 水池占纪念大道的长度比例。

en: Digs a shallow basin with real water (flat ground only, permanent). Otherwise a water-look surface.
zh: 挖出浅池并添加真实水体（仅限平地，永久生效）。否则使用仿水面地表。

en: Quiet garden rooms enclosed by hedges, opening towards the axis.
zh: 以绿篱围合、开口朝向轴线的静谧庭园。

en: What each room holds; Mixed alternates by memorial type.
zh: 各庭园内的布置；混合模式会根据纪念地类型交替安排。

en: Rows of trees either side of the procession, always in pairs.
zh: 纪念大道两侧的行道树，始终成对布置。

en: Trees on the lawns, never in the view along the axis.
zh: 草坪上的树木，不会遮挡轴线方向的视野。

en: The lawns either side of the axis planted as regular groves of trees, mirrored across the axis.
zh: 在轴线两侧草坪上种植规则树阵，并沿轴线镜像对称。

en: A ribbon of flowerbeds (poppies for a war memorial) either side of the procession.
zh: 纪念大道两侧的花坛带（战争纪念地使用罂粟花）。

en: How large the focal monument (or the trail's sculptures) stands, relative to the piece's own size.
zh: 中心纪念碑（或小径雕塑）相对于资产原始大小的缩放比例。

en: Flowerbeds round the forecourt (poppies for a war memorial).
zh: 前庭周围的花坛（战争纪念地使用罂粟花）。

en: Solemn lighting: low bollard lights, lantern pairs, uplights on the monument and rooms only, or none.
zh: 庄重照明：低矮草坪灯、成对灯笼、仅照亮纪念碑和庭园的上照灯，或无照明。

en: A hedge or a fence round the park, with gaps at the entrances.
zh: 环绕公园的绿篱或围栏，在入口处留出缺口。

en: A small round court with flagpoles on its rim and a plaque in the middle.
zh: 小型圆形庭院，边缘设旗杆，中央设纪念牌。

en: The outline leaves no room for an axis; the memorial follows a trail instead.
zh: 此轮廓没有空间布置轴线；纪念设施改为沿小径布置。

en: Part of the procession would leave the area and was left out.
zh: 部分纪念大道会超出区域，已省略。

en: No room for the reflecting pool.
The ground under the pool is not flat (or raised); a water-look surface is used instead of real water.
zh: 池底地面不平（或已抬高）；将使用仿水面地表代替真实水体。

en: The pool basin is dug into the terrain permanently.
Only {0} of {1} sculptures fit beside the trail.
zh: 小径旁仅能容纳 {1} 座雕塑中的 {0} 座。

en: A statue scaled up to monumental size on a stepped plinth at the head of an axis, with an avenue of lamps, flags or trees leading to it.
zh: 在轴线尽端的阶梯基座上放大雕像，形成宏伟纪念雕塑，并以两侧设有路灯、旗帜或树木的大道引导至此。

en: A Palace of Fine Arts style folly made of props: a rotunda of columns round a statue, a lagoon in front and colonnade walks you can stroll through.
zh: 用道具组合成艺术宫风格的园林建筑：立柱环绕雕像构成圆亭，前方有景观湖，并设有可穿行的柱廊步道。

en: A tall obelisk on a stepped base in a paved court with corner pieces, benches and a low hedge ring.
zh: 高耸方尖碑立于阶梯基座，四周为铺装庭院，配有角部装饰、长椅和低矮环形绿篱。

en: A gateway astride a wide walk: a triumphal arch, a pair of pylons or a screen of columns, with statues and flags.
zh: 横跨宽步道的门廊：凯旋门、一对塔门或一排立柱，并配有雕像和旗帜。

en: A walk lined with sculptures on paved pads, each framed by shrubs with a bench facing it.
zh: 沿步道布置铺装雕塑平台，每座雕塑背靠灌木，前方设朝向雕塑的长椅。

en: A circle or oval of terraces with radial spokes and ring walks round a statue or fountain, with a small amphitheatre carved into one side.
zh: 环绕雕像或喷泉的圆形或椭圆形台地，配有放射通道和环形步道，并在一侧挖出小型露天剧场。

en: The {0} was made smaller to fit the free space.
zh: 已缩小{0}，以适应可用空间。

en: The {0} was scaled down to fit its space.
zh: 已按比例缩小{0}，以适应其空间。

en: No columns are installed: trees (or statues) stand in for them.
zh: 未安装立柱资产：将使用树木（或雕像）代替。

en: No arch is installed: a pair of pylons frames the walk instead.
zh: 未安装拱门资产：改用一对塔门框住步道。

en: No obelisk is installed: a monument or statue stands on the base instead.
zh: 未安装方尖碑资产：改在基座上放置纪念碑或雕像。

en: The ground is not flat enough for real water: the pool uses a water-look surface.
zh: 地面不够平坦，无法使用真实水体：水池将使用仿水面地表。

en: Only {0} of {1} sculptures fit along the walk.
zh: 步道沿线仅能容纳 {1} 座雕塑中的 {0} 座。

en: There was no room for the centrepiece in the rotunda.
zh: 圆亭内没有空间放置中心装饰。

en: The amphitheatre needs sunken terraces (seats look down to the stage), so it was left out.
zh: 露天剧场需要下沉台地（座席俯视舞台），因此已省略。

en: A single figure, a group (the main figure with two lesser ones) or a colossus (larger still, on a taller base).
zh: 单座人物雕像、群像（主像加两座较小雕像）或巨像（尺寸更大、基座更高）。

en: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the statue is built. It is scaled down when the space is too small.
zh: 雕像相对于资产原始大小的放大比例。空间不足时会缩小。

en: Raises the ground under the statue in square steps (permanent terrain change).
zh: 在雕像下方以方形台阶形式抬高地面（永久改变地形）。

en: At the far end of the axis, or in the middle with the approach on one side.
zh: 位于轴线远端，或置于中央并从一侧进入。

en: What lines the approach, in matching pairs.
zh: 进入通道两侧成对布置的物体。

en: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the obelisk is built.
zh: 方尖碑相对于资产原始大小的放大比例。

en: Square steps raised in the ground under the obelisk (permanent terrain change). 0 = none.
zh: 在方尖碑下方地面抬起方形台阶（永久改变地形）。0 = 无。

en: Four matching pieces on the court's diagonals.
zh: 庭院对角线上的四个相配装饰。

en: A low hedge round the court with an opening on each axis.
zh: 围绕庭院的低矮绿篱，在每条轴线上留有开口。

en: A triumphal arch astride the walk, a pair of pylons framing it, or a propylaea: a screen of columns with the walk through the middle.
zh: 横跨步道的凯旋门、两侧的一对塔门，或柱式门廊：步道从一排立柱中央穿过。

en: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the arch, pylons or columns are built.
zh: 拱门、塔门或立柱相对于资产原始大小的放大比例。

en: Four statues on the corners of the square, facing along the walk.
zh: 广场四角的四座雕像，朝向步道方向。

en: Paving under and round the gateway.
zh: 门廊下方及周围的铺装。

en: A gentle S-curve, a straight gallery or a zigzag.
zh: 柔和的 S 形曲线、笔直展廊或之字形。

en: How much bigger than the assets' normal size the sculptures are built.
zh: 雕塑相对于资产原始大小的放大比例。

en: Each sculpture a little bigger or smaller, so the walk has rhythm.
zh: 让每座雕塑略大或略小，使步道更有节奏感。

en: An arc of clipped shrubs behind each sculpture.
zh: 每座雕塑后方一圈弧形修剪灌木。

en: Columns in the rotunda's ring. Where the walk passes, the ring opens (with an arch when one is installed).
zh: 圆亭环形布局中的立柱。步道经过处留出开口（安装拱门资产时会设置拱门）。

en: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the columns (and arches) are built.
zh: 立柱（及拱门）相对于资产原始大小的放大比例。

en: Arches where the walk enters and leaves the rotunda (only when arch assets are installed).
zh: 步道进入和离开圆亭处的拱门（仅在安装拱门资产后设置）。

en: Columns on both sides of the walk curving round the lagoon from the rotunda: a colonnade you walk through.
zh: 从圆亭出发，沿景观湖弯曲延伸的步道两侧布置立柱，形成可穿行的柱廊。

en: How far round the lagoon each colonnade arm reaches from the rotunda.
zh: 每侧柱廊从圆亭出发沿景观湖延伸的距离。

en: An oval pool in front of the rotunda, so it is seen across the water.
zh: 圆亭前方的椭圆形水池，可隔水欣赏圆亭。

en: Digs the lagoon and fills it with water (permanent, flat ground only). Otherwise a water-look surface.
zh: 开挖景观湖并注水（永久生效，仅限平地）。否则使用仿水面地表。

en: Shrubs at the ends of the lagoon and a backdrop of trees behind the rotunda.
zh: 景观湖两端的灌木，以及圆亭后方作为背景的树木。

en: Stepping down to the centre (sunken), up to it (a garden mount) or flat. Terraces reshape the ground permanently.
zh: 向中央逐级下沉（下沉式）、逐级抬高（花园丘），或保持平坦。台地会永久重塑地面。

en: Radial walks from the inner ring to the outer ring; one points at the entrance and runs on to it.
zh: 从内环通往外环的放射步道；其中一条朝向入口并延伸至入口。

en: Oval walks on the innermost and outermost terraces, joined to every spoke.
zh: 最内层和最外层台地上的椭圆形步道，与所有放射通道相连。

en: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the central statue is built (fountains up to 200 %).
zh: 中央雕像相对于资产原始大小的放大比例（喷泉最高为 200%）。

en: Carves the side opposite the entrance into rows of seats looking down at a small stage in front of the centrepiece (sunken terraces only).
zh: 将入口对面的侧坡挖成多排座席，俯瞰中心装饰前的小舞台（仅限下沉台地）。

en: Where the big statue goes: the middle, along the longest edge, beside an entrance or tucked into a corner. When it does not fit there, another free spot is used.
zh: 大型雕像的位置：中央、最长边缘沿线、入口旁或角落。所选位置无法容纳时，会改用其他空闲位置。

en: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the big statue.
zh: 从最近的步道添加一条短连接步道至大型雕像。

en: Where the folly goes: the middle, along the longest edge, beside an entrance or tucked into a corner. When it does not fit there, another free spot is used.
zh: 园林观赏建筑的位置：中央、最长边缘沿线、入口旁或角落。所选位置无法容纳时，会改用其他空闲位置。

en: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the folly.
zh: 从最近的步道添加一条短连接步道至园林观赏建筑。

en: Where the obelisk goes: the middle, along the longest edge, beside an entrance or tucked into a corner. When it does not fit there, another free spot is used.
zh: 方尖碑的位置：中央、最长边缘沿线、入口旁或角落。所选位置无法容纳时，会改用其他空闲位置。

en: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the obelisk.
zh: 从最近的步道添加一条短连接步道至方尖碑。

en: Where the gateway goes: the middle, along the longest edge, beside an entrance or tucked into a corner. When it does not fit there, another free spot is used.
zh: 门廊的位置：中央、最长边缘沿线、入口旁或角落。所选位置无法容纳时，会改用其他空闲位置。

en: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the gateway.
zh: 从最近的步道添加一条短连接步道至门廊。

en: Where the sculpture walk goes: the middle, along the longest edge, beside an entrance or tucked into a corner. When it does not fit there, another free spot is used.
zh: 雕塑步道的位置：中央、最长边缘沿线、入口旁或角落。所选位置无法容纳时，会改用其他空闲位置。

en: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the sculpture walk.
zh: 从最近的步道添加一条短连接步道至雕塑步道。

en: Where the terrace garden goes: the middle, along the longest edge, beside an entrance or tucked into a corner. When it does not fit there, another free spot is used.
zh: 台地花园的位置：中央、最长边缘沿线、入口旁或角落。所选位置无法容纳时，会改用其他空闲位置。

en: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the terrace garden.
zh: 从最近的步道添加一条短连接步道至台地花园。

en: An orchard open as a park: fruit trees in rows with mown aisles, blossom meadow, picnics under the trees, beehives and a cider stand.
zh: 向公众开放的果园公园：成排果树与修剪过的草坪通道，配有花卉草甸、树下野餐区、蜂箱和苹果酒摊。

en: Which fruit the orchard grows. Presets set the layout to match; automatic trees prefer that fruit when it is installed.
zh: 果园种植的水果种类。预设会设置匹配的布局；自动选树时会优先选择已安装的相应果树。

en: Square grid, quincunx (every other row offset, like dice fives), tight rows with wide alleys, or blocks of one variety each.
zh: 方形网格、梅花形（隔行错位，类似骰子五点）、树行紧密且通道宽阔的行列，或每块种植单一品种的区块。

en: Distance between the trees (rows: trees closer in the row, alleys wider).
zh: 树木间距（行列模式：行内较密，行间通道较宽）。

en: Rows along the area's long side, across it, or diagonally.
zh: 树行沿区域长边、横向或对角线排列。

en: A cross through the middle, a grid of blocks, a loop inside the edge, or a blossom avenue lined with trees.
zh: 中央十字步道、区块网格、边缘内侧环线，或两侧植树的花径。

en: Distance between the grid paths, and the size of the variety blocks.
zh: 网格步道之间的距离，以及品种区块的大小。

en: Share of planting spots left empty, as in a real old orchard.
zh: 种植位置留空的比例，模拟真实老果园。

en: A row of tall trees along the edge sheltering the orchard.
zh: 沿边缘种植的一排高大树木，为果园挡风。

en: Share of the orchard floor left as long meadow (painted patches with wildflowers).
zh: 果园地面保留为高草草甸的比例（带野花的绘制斑块）。

en: Flower clumps per hectare, mostly in the meadow patches.
zh: 每公顷花丛数量，主要分布在草甸斑块中。

en: Mown strips painted between the tree rows. Permanent terrain texture.
zh: 在果树行间绘制修剪过的草带。地形纹理永久生效。

en: Covers the whole orchard with a mown grass surface (cherry blossom lawns).
zh: 以修剪过的草坪地表覆盖整个果园（樱花草坪）。

en: Terrain layer (1–4) for the meadow patches. Which texture each is depends on the map.
zh: 草甸斑块使用的地形图层（1–4）。各图层的具体纹理取决于地图。

en: Terrain layer (1–4) for the mown aisles.
zh: 修剪草道使用的地形图层（1–4）。

en: Picnic tables in the shade between the trees, beside the paths.
zh: 步道旁、树荫下的野餐桌。

en: A bench along the paths every this many metres (0 = none).
zh: 沿步道每隔此距离（米）放置一张长椅（0 = 无）。

en: Fruit crates and ladders under a few trees.
zh: 部分树下的果箱和梯子。

en: An open lawn in the middle with a veteran tree and benches round it; features like a fountain go there.
zh: 中央开阔草坪，设有一棵老树和环绕长椅；喷泉等设施会放置于此。

en: Orchard park: no room for the central glade.
zh: 果园公园：没有空间容纳中央空地。

en: Orchard park: no room for fruit trees. Make the spacing smaller or the area bigger.
zh: 果园公园：没有空间种植果树。请缩小间距或扩大区域。

en: The stones the ground is laid in, chosen together: main paving, border band, focal pad, walks and inlay accents. Automatic uses the palette this style is designed with. Pick a surface for one role below to make your own mix.
zh: 统一搭配地面石材：主铺装、镶边带、中心平台、步道和嵌饰。自动模式使用该风格的默认搭配。可在下方为单个用途选择地表，自定义组合。

en: The palette this style is designed with: calm stone unless the preset says otherwise.
zh: 该风格的默认材质搭配：除非预设另有指定，否则使用素雅石材。

en: Pale granite slabs · slate border · grey fan-set rondel · herringbone walks
zh: 浅色花岗岩板 · 板岩镶边 · 灰色扇形拼石圆台 · 人字纹步道

en: Smooth sandstone · warm grey paver border · pale flagstone rondel
zh: 光面砂岩 · 暖灰铺路砖镶边 · 浅色石板圆台

en: Muted brick herringbone · granite sett border · grey fan-set rondel
zh: 柔和色调人字纹砖 · 花岗岩块镶边 · 灰色扇形拼石圆台

en: Large concrete slabs · black granite band · polished concrete pad
zh: 大块混凝土板 · 黑色花岗岩带 · 抛光混凝土平台

en: Ochre slabs · orange brick bands · pale stone rondel
zh: 赭色板材 · 橙色砖带 · 浅色石材圆台

en: Granite setts · slate flag border · cobble-fan rondel · flagstone walks
zh: 花岗岩块 · 板岩镶边 · 扇形块石圆台 · 石板步道

en: Soft grey-brown brick · warm sett border · pale flagstone pads
zh: 柔和灰棕砖 · 暖色块石镶边 · 浅色石板平台

en: Your own surfaces: the roles you picked below replace the palette's stones, the rest stay Automatic.
zh: 使用自选地表：下方指定的用途将替换默认搭配中的石材，其余保持自动。

en: The band that frames the paving along the outline (and the ring round the focal pad). Automatic = from the palette.
zh: 沿轮廓框住铺装的条带（以及中心平台周围的环带）。自动 = 使用材质搭配。

en: The round pad under and around the fountain or statue. Automatic = from the palette.
zh: 喷泉或雕像下方及周围的圆形平台。自动 = 使用材质搭配。

en: Walks laid from the entrances to the middle on bigger squares. Automatic = from the palette.
zh: 大型广场上从入口铺向中央的步道。自动 = 使用材质搭配。

en: Thin dark accents: inlay lines, tree pits, an outer ring. Automatic = from the palette.
zh: 纤细的深色装饰：嵌线、树池和外环。自动 = 使用材质搭配。

en: Paths, lawns, trees and benches, with entrances where the area meets streets.
zh: 步道、草坪、树木和长椅，并在区域与街道交接处设置入口。

en: A park with a playground on its largest lawn and a restroom by the paths.
zh: 在最大草坪上设置游乐场，并在步道旁配有厕所的公园。

en: Pitches along a loop of paths in the woods, with restrooms and a picnic area.
zh: 林中环形步道沿线的营位，配有厕所和野餐区。

en: Narrow footpaths everywhere, wide main paths with narrow side paths, or wide paths everywhere.
zh: 全部使用窄步道、宽主步道搭配窄支路，或全部使用宽步道。

en: Trees per hectare of planted ground. Around 25 feels like an open city park, 80 or more like a wood.
zh: 每公顷种植地面的树木数量。约 25 棵呈现开阔城市公园风貌，80 棵以上更像树林。

en: Benches per 100 m of path. Lamps and bins follow the same density.
zh: 每 100 m 步道的长椅数量。路灯和垃圾桶采用相同密度。

en: How many paths to lay out. Automatic adds loops as the park gets bigger.
zh: 布置的步道数量。自动模式会随着公园面积增大而增加环线。

en: Click the outline to place entrances. Without any, entrances are suggested where the park meets streets.
zh: 点击轮廓放置入口。未放置时，会在公园与街道交接处建议入口。

en: Trees and bushes along the boundary, with open gaps so the park stays visible from the street.
zh: 沿边界布置树木和灌木，并保留开口，使街道上仍能看到公园内部。

en: Lets forest animals appear in the larger groves.
zh: 允许森林动物出现在较大的树丛中。

en: Digs a lake into the largest open lawn. The terrain change is permanent: removing the park does not fill it back in.
zh: 在最大的开阔草坪中开挖湖泊。地形变化永久生效：移除公园不会回填湖盆。

en: The lake permanently lowers the terrain. Removing the park leaves the basin.
zh: 湖泊会永久降低地形。移除公园后仍会留下湖盆。

en: There is not enough open space between the paths for a lake.
zh: 步道之间没有足够的空地容纳湖泊。

en: The park idiom: how trees and bushes are composed (groves, belts, lined walks, a strict grid…). Pick a preset to also get the matching path figure.
zh: 公园风格：树木和灌木的构成方式（树丛、林带、行道树、严格网格等）。选择预设还可获得匹配的步道形式。

en: Extra open lawn kept free of planting for picnic groups (with the Picnic feature on).
zh: 额外保留不种植植被的开阔草坪，供团体野餐使用（需开启野餐设施）。

en: There is no free room for the {0} in this park.
zh: 此公园中没有空间放置{0}。

en: The {0} did not fit at the chosen position and was placed elsewhere.
zh: 所选位置无法容纳{0}，已放置到其他位置。

en: Side length of each pitch. Tents need about 8 m, caravans 12 m or more.
zh: 每个营位的边长。帐篷约需 8 m，房车需 12 m 或以上。

en: Restrooms beside the paths, one for every 25 pitches.
zh: 步道旁的厕所，每 25 个营位配置一间。

en: No pitch fits along the paths. Try a smaller pitch size or a larger area.
zh: 步道沿线无法容纳营位。请尝试缩小营位或扩大区域。

en: No {0} are installed, so none were placed.
The area outline is not valid (it crosses itself or is too thin).
zh: 区域轮廓无效（自相交或过于狭窄）。

en: The area is too small ({0} m², needs at least {1} m²).
zh: 区域太小（{0} m²，至少需要 {1} m²）。

en: The area is too large ({0} m², at most {1} m²).
zh: 区域太大（{0} m²，最多允许 {1} m²）。

en: Part of the ground surface has a shape the game cannot draw and was left out.
zh: 部分地表形状无法被游戏绘制，已省略。

en: There is no free space left for {0}.
How the spaces sit against the driving lane. Angled spaces are easier to drive into but fit fewer cars.
zh: 停车位相对于车道的角度。斜列车位更容易驶入，但可容纳的车辆更少。

en: Spaces at right angles to the lane. Fits the most cars.
zh: 停车位与车道垂直。可容纳最多车辆。

en: Slanted spaces, a little easier to drive into.
zh: 略微倾斜的车位，更容易驶入。

en: Strongly slanted spaces. Easiest to drive into, fits the fewest cars.
zh: 大角度倾斜的车位。最容易驶入，但容纳车辆最少。

en: Where cars and people get in and out. We put entrances on the nearest street for you; pick a type, click the outline next to a street to add one, right-click one to remove it.
zh: 车辆和行人的出入口。会自动在最近街道处设置入口；选择类型后点击街道旁的轮廓添加，右键点击入口可移除。

en: Cars come in and go out here. Joins the street without changing it.
zh: 车辆从这里驶入和驶出。

en: Cars can only drive in here. Needs a way out somewhere else.
zh: 仅可驶入，需在其他位置设置出口。

en: Cars can only drive out here. Needs a way in somewhere else.
zh: 仅可驶出，需在其他位置设置入口。

en: Cars come in and go out through a real junction: the kerb opens and the street gets a crossing. Uses a few building plots on the street.
zh: 车辆通过真实路口进出：路缘打开，街道新增人行横道。会占用少量沿街建筑地块。

en: A junction where cars can only drive in. Needs a way out somewhere else.
zh: 仅允许车辆驶入的路口。需要在其他位置设置出口。

en: A junction where cars can only drive out. Needs a way in somewhere else.
zh: 仅允许车辆驶出的路口。需要在其他位置设置入口。

en: A path for people only, from the lot to the sidewalk. Does not count as a car entrance.
zh: 从停车场通往人行道的行人专用步道。不计为车辆入口。

en: A bus stop on the street in front of the lot.
zh: 停车场前方街道上的公交站。

en: Keeps a strip by the street free for buildings at this spot. Width and depth are set under Buildings.
zh: 在此处沿街预留一条供建筑使用的空地。宽度和深度在“建筑”中设置。

en: Leaves a strip next to the street for buildings to grow on. The lot shrinks to make room.
zh: 在街道旁预留一条可生长建筑的空地。停车场会相应缩小。

en: The parking lot uses the whole area.
Buildings along the side with the longest street frontage.
zh: 沿临街长度最长的一侧布置建筑。

en: Buildings along every side that faces a street.
zh: 沿每个面向街道的边缘布置建筑。

en: What may be built there: homes, shops, offices… Automatic uses the city's usual zone.
zh: 允许建造的类型：住宅、商店、办公楼等。自动模式使用城市常用分区。

en: How many plots deep the buildings reach, counted from the street (one plot is 8 m, the game allows up to 6).
zh: 建筑从街道向内延伸的网格数量（每格 8 m，游戏最多允许 6 格）。

en: How many plots wide each building plot marker is (one plot is 8 m).
zh: 每个建筑地块标记的宽度，以网格数计（每格 8 m）。

en: The surface laid under the lanes and spaces.
zh: 车道和停车位下方铺设的地表。

en: Where grass, trees and bushes go instead of pavement.
zh: 以草地代替铺面的区域。

en: Paved from edge to edge. No trees.
zh: 整个区域全部铺装。不种树。

en: Planting along the outline and at the ends of rows. Rows sit back to back.
zh: 沿轮廓和每排末端布置绿化。车位背靠背排列。

en: Also a planted strip between back-to-back rows. Costs some spaces.
zh: 在背靠背的两排车位之间加入草带。

en: Wider lanes give cars more room to turn in.
zh: 加宽通道，增加车辆操作空间。

en: A planted strip between the outline and the first spaces. Tidier, costs spaces.
zh: 增大与轮廓的退距，更整齐但减少车位。

en: Which way the rows of spaces run.
Rows run parallel to the longest straight side of the outline.
zh: 车位排平行于轮廓最长的直边。

en: Rows run at right angles to the longest side.
Sets the row angle for the whole lot.
zh: 设置整个停车场的排列角度。

en: On sloped ground every row of spaces is levelled into a terrace (at most 2 % fall), with gentle ramps (at most 8 %) between the terraces. Off: the lot follows the ground as it is.
zh: 在斜坡上将每排车位整平成台地（最大坡度 2%），台地之间以缓坡连接（最大坡度 8%）。关闭时，停车场顺应现有地面。

en: The ground is steep here: levelling the lot moves up to {0} m of earth at its edges.
zh: 此处地形较陡：整平停车场时，边缘最多需要调整 {0} m 的土方高度。

en: A driving lane along the whole outline with a row of spaces on the outside. Off uses the full area for rows.
zh: 沿整个轮廓布置车道，外侧设一排车位。关闭后，整个区域都用于排列车位。

en: Spaces between short lanes that join neighbouring rows. 0 = none.
zh: 连接相邻车位排的短车道之间所隔的车位数。0 = 无。

en: How an entrance joins the street outside.
zh: 入口与外部街道的连接方式。

en: An invisible lane that joins the street without changing it.
zh: 以隐形车道连接街道，不改变街道本身。

en: Builds a small alley into the street. The street gets a real junction and its kerb opens up; it costs a few zoning cells there.
zh: 修建一小段巷道接入街道。街道会生成真实路口并打开路缘；会占用此处少量分区网格。

en: Ends each row with a patch of grass. Off packs in more cars.
zh: 用草地封住每排末端，关闭时可容纳更多车辆。

en: Width of the planted strip between back-to-back rows.
zh: 背靠背车位排之间绿化带的宽度。

en: The surface laid where there is no pavement.
zh: 未铺装位置使用的地表。

en: Tree types to plant. Empty = a mix of street trees.
zh: 种植的树种。留空 = 混合行道树。

en: Bush types to plant. Empty = a mix of bushes.
zh: 种植的灌木品种。留空 = 混合灌木。

en: How much of the green is planted.
zh: 绿地内植被的种植比例。

en: Places street lights along the rows; lit at night.
zh: 沿排列方向放置路灯，夜间照明

en: Which street light to use. Automatic picks single and double lights.
zh: 使用的路灯类型。自动模式选择单头灯和双头灯。

en: Largest gap between two lights along a row.
zh: 沿排列方向两盏路灯之间的最大间距

en: Share of spaces with a charger. Chargers stand in the planting behind a pair of spaces, close to the entrance.
zh: 配有充电桩的车位比例。充电桩位于靠近入口的一对车位后方绿化带中。

en: Share of wide spaces for disabled drivers, placed closest to the entrance.
zh: 供残障驾驶者使用的加宽车位比例，放在最靠近入口的位置。

en: What a car pays to park here.
zh: 车辆在此停车需支付的费用。

en: An entry without an exit - cars could not leave.
zh: 只有入口没有出口，车辆无法离开。

en: An exit without an entry - place an entry.
zh: 只有出口没有入口，请放置入口。

en: This outline crosses itself. Move a corner so the edges don't cross.
zh: 此轮廓自相交。请移动拐角，使边缘不再交叉。

en: Too small for a parking lot ({0} m², needs at least {1} m²).
zh: 面积太小，无法建造停车场（{0} m²，至少需要 {1} m²）。

en: Too narrow for parking rows once the edge margin is taken off. Make the area wider, or the edge margin smaller.
zh: 扣除边缘留空后太窄，无法排列停车位。请加宽区域或缩小边缘留空。

en: Too large for one parking lot ({0} m², at most {1} m²). Split it into smaller areas.
zh: 面积过大，无法作为单个停车场（{0} m²，最多允许 {1} m²）。请拆分为较小区域。

en: No entrance for cars yet. Pick an entrance type and click the outline next to a street.
zh: 尚无车辆入口。请选择入口类型，并点击街道旁的轮廓。

en: Entrances were placed on the nearest road. Move them along the outline if you like.
zh: 已在最近道路旁设置入口。可沿轮廓移动入口。

en: Entrance {0} has no straight path to a driving lane. Move the entrance.
zh: 出入口 {0} 没有直达通道的路径，请移动它。

en: Entrance {0} has no street outside it. Cars can only use it if a street is built there.
zh: 入口 {0} 外没有街道。在此修建街道后，车辆才能使用该入口。

en: Two entrances are on top of each other - one was left out.
zh: 两个入口重叠，已省略其中一个。

en: {0} spaces could not be reached from an entrance and were left out.
zh: 有 {0} 个车位无法从入口到达，已省略。

en: Too narrow for a lane around the lot - built without it.
zh: 区域太窄，无法设置周边车道，已省略该车道。

en: {0} m² of pavement or grass is missing: the game cannot display this shape there.
zh: 缺少 {0} m² 的铺装或草地：游戏无法在此显示该形状。

en: The parking lot could not be planned: {0}
No parking space fits here. Try a wider area, narrower spaces or no lane around the lot.
zh: 此处无法容纳停车位。请尝试加宽区域、缩窄车位或关闭周边车道。

en: {0} spaces were left out because something else is already planned there.
zh: 有 {0} 个车位因该处已规划其他内容而被省略。

en: No room for chargers: they need planting behind the spaces.
zh: 没有空间放置充电桩：需要车位后方有绿化带。

en: No room for accessible spaces: they need a row of straight (90°) spaces.
zh: 没有空间放置无障碍车位：需要一排垂直（90°）车位。

en: The game cannot use this outline as one lot. Smooth out very sharp corners.
zh: 游戏无法将此轮廓用作单个停车场。请平滑过于尖锐的拐角。

en: At most {0} entrances per lot - {1} were left out.
zh: 每个停车场最多允许 {0} 个入口，已省略 {1} 个。

en: Bus stop {0} has no street in front of it. Move it next to a street.
zh: 公交站 {0} 前方没有街道。请将其移至街道旁。

en: No side of this lot faces a street, so no buildings can grow along it.
zh: 此停车场没有临街边缘，因此沿边无法生长建筑。

en: This building plot is not next to a street. Move it to a side that faces one.
zh: 此建筑地块不临街。请移至面向街道的一侧。

en: The street is too far away for buildings this deep. Increase the building depth or draw the lot closer to the street.
zh: 街道太远，当前建筑深度无法连接。请增加建筑深度，或将停车场画得更靠近街道。

en: The building strips would leave no room for parking - built without them.
zh: 建筑带会导致停车场无剩余空间，已省略建筑带。

en: {0} building strips were left out because parking runs through them.
zh: 有 {0} 条建筑带因停车区域穿过而被省略。

en: A wide cycle route through the park between two far-apart entrances, kept apart from the footpaths and crossing them square. Uses a bike path when one is installed, otherwise a wide path.
zh: 在两个相距较远的入口之间设置贯穿公园的宽自行车路线，与步道分开，并以直角交叉。已安装自行车道时使用自行车道，否则使用宽步道。

en: How far the bike route keeps from footpaths running alongside it.
zh: 自行车路线与平行人行步道之间的距离。

en: Automatic picks the two-way bike path, then a path with bike lanes, then a wide footpath.
zh: 自动模式依次优先选择双向自行车道、带自行车道的步道、宽人行步道。

en: Narrow paths across the larger lawns, joining two main paths.
zh: 穿过较大草坪、连接两条主步道的窄步道。

en: Informal trails winding through the planted belt along the park's edge, joined to the nearest path.
zh: 沿公园边缘绿化带蜿蜒延伸的自然小径，连接最近的步道。

en: Automatic picks a gravel or dirt path when one is installed, otherwise a footpath.
zh: 自动模式优先使用已安装的碎石或泥土步道，否则使用人行步道。

en: Desire lines: shortcuts people take where the paths make them walk around. Worn = trodden ground (terrain paint), paved = small paths.
zh: 自发形成的捷径：在人们需沿步道绕行的地方抄近路。踩损 = 踩踏地面（地形绘制），铺装 = 小步道。

en: Ground texture for the worn shortcuts: 1 dry grass, 2 forest floor, 3 dirt, 4 sand on vanilla maps (other maps: the closest material).
zh: 踩损捷径的地面纹理：原版地图中，1 为干草、2 为林下地面、3 为泥土、4 为沙地（其他地图使用最接近的材质）。

en: Path net: a real dirt/gravel path. Painted: trodden dirt painted into the ground (frayed, natural); people can walk it only when an invisible pedestrian path is available, otherwise it is just a look. Painting is permanent.
zh: 步道网络：真实泥土／碎石步道。绘制：在地面绘制踩踏泥土（边缘散乱、自然）；仅在有隐形人行步道时可供行走，否则仅为外观。绘制永久生效。

en: Painted trails are a look only: no invisible pedestrian path in this playset, so nobody walks them.
zh: 绘制小径仅具外观效果：当前模组播放集中没有隐形人行步道，因此行人不会使用。

en: The bike route needs two bike entrances at least 40 m apart.
zh: 自行车路线需要两个相距至少 40 m 的自行车入口。

en: No room for a bike route through the park.
zh: 没有空间设置贯穿公园的自行车路线。

en: Fewer small paths fit than asked for.
zh: 可容纳的小步道数量少于要求。

en: No room for dirt trails along the edge.
zh: 边缘没有空间设置泥土小径。

en: The paths are already direct: no shortcuts needed.
zh: 现有步道已足够直接，无需捷径。

en: Patches of dirt, mown grass, meadow, rocks, gravel or sand with soft, blended edges.
zh: 泥土、修剪草坪、草甸、岩石、碎石或沙地斑块，边缘柔和融合。

en: The bike route is on, but there are no bike entrances. Place two bike entrances on the outline.
zh: 已开启自行车路线，但没有自行车入口。请在轮廓上放置两个自行车入口。

en: People walk in here. A thin path joins the park paths.
zh: 行人从此进入。一条窄步道连接公园步道。

en: Cyclists and pedestrians come in here. The bike route runs between bike entrances. Best facing a bike path or a road with bike lanes.
zh: 骑行者和行人从此进入。自行车路线连接各自行车入口。最好面向自行车道或带自行车道的道路。

en: The grand entrance: a wide main walk and a gateway of planters and lamps. Best on a big road.
zh: 宏伟入口：宽主步道及由花箱和路灯构成的入口景观。最好设在大路旁。

en: Maintenance access: a short service track to the paths. Best on a quiet street.
zh: 维护通道：一条短服务道路接入步道。最好设在安静街道旁。

en: Place at least one entrance on the outline. The faint markers show good spots.
zh: 请至少在轮廓上放置一个入口。淡色标记表示合适位置。
公园吸引力计入旅游业

en: Parks and plazas you build add their attractiveness to the city's tourism, like vanilla parks. Turning it off removes it from existing builds on the next load.
zh: 建造的公园和广场会像原版公园一样，将吸引力计入城市旅游业。关闭后，下次载入时会从已有建设中移除此效果。
真实公园属性（附属建筑）

en: Each park gets a small hidden park building at its road edge, so leisure, wellbeing coverage and upkeep work like a vanilla park. Off: only attractiveness counts. Turning it off removes the companions on the next load.
zh: 每个公园的临路边缘会添加一座小型隐藏公园建筑，使休闲、幸福度覆盖和维护费像原版公园一样生效。关闭时仅计入吸引力。关闭后，下次载入时会移除附属建筑。

en: No road edge: only attractiveness applies.
zh: 没有临路边缘：仅吸引力生效。

en: Size {0} m² gives a base of {1} (1.9 × (area ÷ 1,000 m²)^0.85, fitted to vanilla parks).
zh: 面积 {0} m² 对应基础值 {1}（1.9 ×（面积 ÷ 1,000 m²）^0.85，按原版公园拟合）。

en: Quality ×{0} = 0.55 + trees {1} + water {2} + landmarks {3} + amenities {4} + play and sport {5} + seating {6}.

zh: 类型 ×{0}，因此基础值 × 品质 × 类型 ≈ {1}。

en: Vanilla parks of a similar size, scaled to this size: {0} to {1}.
zh: 类似面积的原版公园，按此面积缩放后：{0} 至 {1}。

en: In game it is multiplied by the terrain bonus (forest, shore, height: up to +40 %) when built. The city adds every park's attractiveness² ÷ 10,000 into its tourism.
zh: 建造时，游戏会乘以地形加成（森林、岸边、高度：最高 +40%）。城市将各公园的吸引力² ÷ 10,000 计入旅游业。

en: Vanilla parks: each visit raises a citizen's leisure by about this ÷ 5 per update until they are satisfied.
zh: 原版公园：每次到访时，每次更新约增加此值 ÷ 5 的市民休闲度，直至满足需求。

en: Vanilla parks: coverage fades with walking distance as 1 − (distance ÷ range)², times the entertainment strength.
zh: 原版公园：覆盖效果随步行距离按 1 −（距离 ÷ 范围）² 衰减，再乘以娱乐强度。

en: Vanilla parks: each covered street uses up capacity by its length and density; when it runs out, coverage fades.
zh: 原版公园：每条被覆盖的街道会按长度和密度消耗容量；容量耗尽时，覆盖效果会减弱。

en: Vanilla parks: residents get up to 20 wellbeing from park coverage (20 × √(coverage ÷ 1.5), at most 20).
zh: 原版公园：居民最多从公园覆盖获得 20 点幸福度（20 × √(覆盖度 ÷ 1.5)，最高为 20）。

en: What a vanilla park this good costs to run (about a fifth of its price per month).
zh: 同等品质原版公园的运营费用（每月约为其造价的五分之一）。

en: A walkable paved square with a centerpiece and seating.
zh: 可供行人自由通行的铺装广场，配有中心装饰和座椅。

en: How many times the furniture arrangement is placed. Around the centre they come in facing pairs.
zh: 街具组合的放置次数。在中心周围会以面对面的成对形式布置。

en: Space kept free around the centerpiece (radius). Raise it for a bigger fountain.
zh: 中心装饰周围预留的空间（半径）。使用较大喷泉时请增大此值。

en: Up to five items placed side by side, for example bench – lamp – bench.
zh: 最多五个物品并排布置，例如长椅—路灯—长椅。

en: Lets pedestrians cross the whole plaza freely instead of only along paths.
zh: 允许行人在整个广场自由穿行，而不局限于步道。

en: Click the outline where people enter. Without any, access points are suggested along adjacent streets.
zh: 点击轮廓设置行人入口。未设置时，会沿相邻街道建议出入口。

en: The centerpiece does not fit this plaza and was left out.
zh: 此广场无法容纳中心装饰，已省略。

en: There is no free room for the {0} on this square.
The square is too small for these levels (needs about 24 × 16 m).
zh: 广场太小，无法设置这些层级（约需 24 × 16 m）。

en: The stones the square is laid in: field, framing bands, light accents and dark inlays. Automatic follows the square's character.
zh: 广场铺装石材：主体、镶边带、浅色装饰和深色嵌饰。自动模式遵循广场风格。

en: No room for lawns between the axes; make the square bigger or lower the lawn share.
zh: 轴线之间没有空间布置草坪；请扩大广场或降低草坪比例。
已为 {0} 座建筑扩展庭院

en: How far a garden reaches sideways to meet the neighbour beside it. Very large values make outgrow slower in big cities.
zh: 庭院向两侧延伸至邻居的距离。数值过大会降低大型城市中庭院扩展的速度。

en: Two neighbours this far apart at the street still join (one shared fence or hedge).
zh: 相邻庭院在街道处相距不超过此值时仍会连接（共用一道围栏或绿篱）。

en: How far apart their back corners may be (wedges on the outside of a curve).
zh: 两个庭院后角允许的最大间距（适用于弯道外侧的楔形空地）。

en: Two gardens back to back this far apart meet in the middle.
zh: 背靠背的两个庭院相距不超过此值时，会在中间汇合。

en: A side facing another house's side or back this far away meets it halfway.
zh: 一侧面向另一房屋的侧面或背面，且距离不超过此值时，会在中途汇合。

en: A shallow garden reaches back to its row's deepest by up to this much.
zh: 较浅的庭院最多向后延伸此距离，以对齐同排最深的庭院。

en: A side or back nobody else has grows out to a road, path or building near it and hugs it.
zh: 没有相邻庭院的侧面或后方会向附近道路、步道或建筑延伸，并贴合其边缘。

en: How far a garden reaches out to a road, path or building.
zh: 庭院向道路、步道或建筑延伸的距离。

en: A side or back with nothing near it still grows this far into open land. Very large values fill whole fields.
zh: 侧面或后方没有附近物体时，仍向空地延伸此距离。数值很大时会填满整片空地。

en: A garden stops growing where the land gets steeper than this, so it never climbs a cliff. 80 %: only real cliffs and walls stop it. 0: no limit.
zh: 地面坡度超过此值时，庭院停止延伸，避免爬上悬崖。80%：仅真正的悬崖和墙壁会阻挡。0：不限。

en: A garden stops growing where the land is more than this above or below its house (m). 0: no limit (the default).
zh: 当地面高于或低于房屋超过此距离（米）时，庭院停止延伸。0：不限（默认值）。

en: A garden grows under an elevated road or a bridge only where its road is at least this high above the ground (m). Lower, it is a crack and nothing grows there. Trees never grow under one.
zh: 只有当高架道路或桥梁距地面的高度至少达到此值（米）时，其下方才会生成花园。低于此高度时，桥下空间过于狭窄，不会生成植被。树木始终不会在桥下生成。

en: Two deep gardens meet behind a shallow one between them.
zh: 两侧较深的庭院在中间较浅庭院的后方汇合。

en: A garden open at the back closes with a fence or hedge the joining freed.
zh: 用庭院连接后腾出的围栏或绿篱，封闭原本开放的后边界。

en: Every open edge of a garden (not its street front) gets fence or hedge pieces, following its bends and the roads it hugs.
zh: 为庭院所有开放边缘（临街正面除外）添加围栏或绿篱，沿其弯曲边界和贴合的道路布置。

en: What closes the open edges: the house's own fence or hedge kind, or one for every house.
zh: 封闭开放边缘使用的类型：沿用房屋自身的围栏或绿篱，或所有房屋统一使用一种类型。

en: A garden's lawn grows to its new fences, around driveways and paving.
zh: 庭院草坪延伸至新围栏，并绕开车行通道和铺装。

en: Mowed lawn this far from the house; a big garden is painted further out. 400 or more: lawn everywhere.
zh: 房屋周围此距离内使用修剪草坪；大型庭院更远处改用绘制。400 及以上：全部使用草坪。

en: How many gardens are painted instead of keeping their lawns. Natural and Yard more often, Tidy seldom.
zh: 改用地形绘制而非保留草坪的庭院比例。自然风格和堆场风格较多，整洁风格较少。

en: How strong the paint of a painted garden is.
Soft ground past the gardens and worn ground along fences facing open land.
zh: 庭院外的柔和地面，以及面向空地的围栏沿线的踩损地面。

en: How far the paint reaches past the gardens.
zh: 绘制效果超出庭院的距离。

en: How far the fainter, wider band reaches.
zh: 较淡、较宽的外围带延伸的距离。

en: How strong the paint past the gardens is.
zh: 庭院外绘制纹理的强度。

en: The ground a painted garden is painted with.
zh: 绘制庭院所用的地面纹理。

en: The ground of a big garden beyond its lawn near the house.
zh: 大型庭院中，房屋附近草坪以外的地面。

en: The ground of the band just past the gardens.
zh: 紧邻庭院外侧条带的地面纹理。

en: The ground of the wider, fainter band further out.
zh: 更外围较宽、较淡条带的地面纹理。

en: Worn ground along back fences that face open land.
zh: 面向空地的后围栏沿线的踩损地面。

en: How wide the worn band along those fences is.
zh: 这些围栏沿线踩损带的宽度。

en: A band along the roads and paths beside the gardens.
zh: 庭院旁道路和步道沿线的条带。

en: How wide the band along roads and paths is.
zh: 道路和步道沿线条带的宽度。

en: The ground under rock gardens and outcrops.
zh: 岩石花园和露头下方的地面。

en: The wider ground around an outcrop.
zh: 岩石露头周围更大范围的地面。

en: The ground of a storage yard.
The ground of the worn patches in big gardens.
zh: 大型庭院中踩损斑块的地面纹理。

en: How many worn patches big gardens get.
zh: 大型庭院获得踩损斑块的数量。

en: Planted beds with bushes along new fences. Off: no planting, features, paths or rocks.
zh: 沿新围栏布置种有灌木的种植床。关闭时，不添加植被、设施、步道或岩石。

en: How often a new fence gets a bed with bushes.
zh: 新围栏旁出现灌木种植床的频率。

en: The most bushes the beds of one garden get.
zh: 单个庭院种植床内的最大灌木数量。

en: Big new garden land gets something by its look: a rock garden, a sand pit, a log pile, a bench nook, a flower garden, a storage yard.
zh: 较大的新增庭院区域会按风格添加内容：岩石花园、沙坑、原木堆、长椅角、花园或仓储场。

en: How many big gardens get a feature.
zh: 大型庭院获得设施的比例。

en: A big garden gets one more feature for every this much new land (at most 6).
zh: 大型庭院每增加此面积的土地，就多获得一个设施（最多 6 个）。

en: New garden land a feature needs.
zh: 一个设施所需的新增庭院面积。

en: How often a rock sits where two gardens meet at the street (never against a hedge).
zh: 两个庭院在临街交界处放置岩石的频率（不会紧靠绿篱）。

en: How many big gardens get a paved path from the house to the back.
zh: 大型庭院获得从房屋通向后院的铺装步道的比例。

en: A narrow even gap between two houses becomes a paved walkway.
zh: 两栋房屋之间狭窄且均匀的空隙会变成铺装步行通道。

en: How often a narrow gap becomes a walkway.
zh: 狭窄空隙变为步行通道的频率。

en: Shops, offices and works fill the land between them with the surface most of their ground already is, not lawn.
zh: 商店、办公楼和工厂之间的空地，使用其现有地面中占比最高的地表填充，而非草坪。

en: On: the empty zone cells of the area get the zones below, as lots that start at the road. Off: only the buildings already there are edited (each zone type by its own Outgrow settings).
zh: 开启：将区域中的空白分区网格划为下列分区，地块从道路开始延伸。关闭：仅编辑现有建筑（各分区类型采用各自的庭院扩展设置）。

en: The main zone of the area.
A second zone mixed in (its share below).
zh: 混合加入的第二种分区（比例在下方设置）。

en: A third zone mixed in (its share below).
zh: 混合加入的第三种分区（比例在下方设置）。

en: Any zone of the game (mods' zones too) instead of the zone type above.
zh: 选择游戏中的任意分区（包括模组分区），替代上方的分区类型。

en: Any zone of the game instead of the second zone type.
zh: 选择游戏中的任意分区，替代第二分区类型。

en: Any zone of the game instead of the third zone type.
zh: 选择游戏中的任意分区，替代第三分区类型。

en: How much of the land the main zone gets (%); what the zones leave stays empty.
zh: 主要分区占土地的比例（%）；各分区未占用的部分保持为空。

en: How much of the land the second zone gets (%). 0: none.
zh: 第二分区占土地的比例（%）。0：无。

en: How much of the land the third zone gets (%). 0: none.
zh: 第三分区占土地的比例（%）。0：无。

en: How the lots of the zones follow each other along the roads: at random, in clumps of lots alike, or spread evenly.
zh: 各类分区地块沿道路的排列方式：随机、相同地块成组，或均匀分布。

en: About how many lots in a row get the same zone.
zh: 大约有多少连续地块使用相同分区。

en: On sloped land every lot becomes level at the height it meets its road, with banks blending into the land around (painted). A lot that would need more earth than the limit is made shallower, or left empty. Lots already level are left alone.
zh: 在斜坡上，将每个地块整平至其与道路衔接处的高度，并以边坡融入周围地面（同时绘制纹理）。所需土方超过限制时，会缩短地块深度或留空。已平整的地块不变。

en: The deepest cut or highest fill a lot may need (m). Lots on steeper land are made shallower or left empty.
zh: 地块允许的最大开挖深度或填土高度（米）。更陡地面上的地块会缩短深度或留空。

en: No bank around the levelled lots is steeper than this (50 % = 1 in 2).
zh: 整平地块周围的边坡不得超过此坡度（50% = 1:2）。

en: Where a lot's back meets ground 2.6 m or more above it (the lot behind it, or the hill), a concrete wall stands there with a walk along its top, instead of a bank that takes the lots' ground. The lot behind gives up the row under the walk.
zh: 当地块后方相邻地面（后方地块或山坡）高出至少 2.6 m 时，设置顶部带步道的混凝土墙，避免边坡占用地块。后方地块会让出步道下方的一排网格。

en: The blocks along roads at least this wide get their own zone (shops along the big roads…).
zh: 沿宽度至少达到此值的道路，街区会采用独立分区（例如在大路沿线布置商店）。

en: The zone the cells along the big roads get.
zh: 大路沿线网格采用的分区。

en: How wide a road must be for the road rule.
zh: 道路达到此宽度后才应用大路分区规则。

en: How deep the lots along those roads are, in zone cells.
zh: 这些道路沿线地块的深度，以分区网格计。

en: The narrowest lot of the main zone along the road, in zone cells (8 m).
zh: 主要分区沿路地块的最小宽度，以分区网格（8 m）计。

en: The widest lot of the main zone along the road, in zone cells.
zh: 主要分区沿路地块的最大宽度，以分区网格计。

en: The shallowest lot of the main zone back from the road, in zone cells.
zh: 主要分区地块从道路向后的最小深度，以分区网格计。

en: The deepest lot of the main zone back from the road, in zone cells (6 at most).
zh: 主要分区地块从道路向后的最大深度，以分区网格计（最多 6 格）。

en: The narrowest lot of the second zone along the road, in zone cells (8 m).
zh: 第二分区沿路地块的最小宽度，以分区网格（8 m）计。

en: The widest lot of the second zone along the road, in zone cells.
zh: 第二分区沿路地块的最大宽度，以分区网格计。

en: The shallowest lot of the second zone back from the road, in zone cells.
zh: 第二分区地块从道路向后的最小深度，以分区网格计。

en: The deepest lot of the second zone back from the road, in zone cells (6 at most).
zh: 第二分区地块从道路向后的最大深度，以分区网格计（最多 6 格）。

en: The narrowest lot of the third zone along the road, in zone cells (8 m).
zh: 第三分区沿路地块的最小宽度，以分区网格（8 m）计。

en: The widest lot of the third zone along the road, in zone cells.
zh: 第三分区沿路地块的最大宽度，以分区网格计。

en: The shallowest lot of the third zone back from the road, in zone cells.
zh: 第三分区地块从道路向后的最小深度，以分区网格计。

en: The deepest lot of the third zone back from the road, in zone cells (6 at most).
zh: 第三分区地块从道路向后的最大深度，以分区网格计（最多 6 格）。

en: The lots in the area grow past their borders over the land around them, by the look: shared fences and hedges, lawns, ground, beds, paths (the settings below). They never grow into roads, buildings, other lots, your builds or water. With Zoning on, the houses that grow there later outgrow too. Off: the area is only zoned.
zh: 区域内地块会按风格越过原边界向周围土地扩展：共用围栏和绿篱、草坪、地面、种植床、步道（见下方设置）。不会延伸至道路、建筑、其他地块、你的建设或水体中。开启分区后，日后在此生长的房屋也会扩展庭院。关闭：仅对区域进行分区。

en: Switch on Zoning or Outgrow: there is nothing to build.
zh: 请开启分区或庭院扩展：当前没有可建造内容。

en: Detached houses with gardens that outgrow their lots. Styles: corner shops, leafy, tight.
zh: 独栋住宅，庭院向地块外扩展。风格：街角商店、绿树成荫、紧凑。

en: Houses spread out with fields between them, in clumps. Styles: hamlet, village green, country lanes.
zh: 房屋成组分散布置，之间保留田地。风格：小村落、村庄绿地、乡间小路。

en: Rows of town houses on narrow lots. Styles: terraces, mews, corner shops.
zh: 在狭窄地块上成排布置住宅。风格：连排住宅、巷院住宅、街角商店。

en: Shops along the street, homes between them; the big roads get the big shops. Styles: high street, boulevard, market town.
zh: 沿街布置商店，其间穿插住宅；大路沿线安排大型商店。风格：商业街、林荫大道、集镇。

en: Flats over shops, homes and a few offices: the middle of a town. Styles: old town, new town, square.
zh: 商店上方的公寓、住宅和少量办公楼，形成城镇中心。风格：老城、新城、广场。

en: Towers: flats, offices and big shops. Styles: business district, city living, shopping.
zh: 高层建筑：公寓、办公楼和大型商店。风格：商务区、城市居住、购物。

en: Offices in green grounds. Styles: campus, office strip, tech park.
zh: 绿地中的办公楼。风格：园区、办公带、科技园。

en: Works and yards. Styles: mixed yards, trade park, big works.
zh: 工厂和堆场。风格：混合堆场、商贸园、大型厂区。

en: Houses by the water and a few shops. Styles: beach houses, promenade, resort.
zh: 水边住宅和少量商店。风格：海滨住宅、海滨步道、度假区。

en: How much of the empty land gets zoned: the rest of the lots along the roads stay empty (mixed in the same way as the zones).
zh: 空地中划分分区的比例：其余沿路地块保持为空（采用与分区相同的混合方式）。

en: The narrowest road this zone goes on (m; a two-lane road is 16 m).
zh: 此分区适用的最窄道路（米；双车道道路为 16 m）。

en: The widest road this zone goes on (m; 48: any).
zh: 此分区适用的最宽道路（米；48 表示任意）。

en: Each zone type's own Outgrow switch and settings (set in the panel).
zh: 各分区类型独立的庭院扩展开关和设置（在面板中设置）。

en: What a building's land past its own lot becomes, whatever the building is: a garden (lawn, fences, beds), a car park yard (green edges, bins, marked bays with parked cars), or paving. The outgrow type alone decides: whatever the building is (a house given a car park type gets a car park).
zh: 建筑原地块之外的土地用途，与建筑类型无关：花园（草坪、围栏、种植床）、停车院（绿化边缘、垃圾桶、带停放车辆的标线车位）或铺装。仅由庭院扩展类型决定：例如为住宅指定停车场类型，也会生成停车场。

en: How a car park yard looks. Clean: a wide grass edge, trees in planters at the ends of the rows, a tidy bin corner. Everyday: grass edges, bins and stock, most bays taken. Industrial: concrete, no grass, more vans, pallets, barrels, skips and containers, dry worn ground further out.
zh: 停车院的外观。整洁：宽草地边缘、各排末端花箱中的树木、整齐的垃圾桶角。日常：草地边缘、垃圾桶和货物，多数车位被占用。工业：混凝土、无草地，更多厢式货车、托盘、桶、垃圾斗和集装箱，外围为干燥踩损地面。

en: How far out from the building its car park yard is paved and parked. Further out, the land is the outgrow type's own: its ground, patches, rocks and things.
zh: 建筑停车院铺装和停放车辆向外延伸的距离。更远处采用庭院扩展类型自身的地面、斑块、岩石和物品。

en: The share of parking bays with a car or van in them.
zh: 停有汽车或厢式货车的停车位比例。

en: The chance a car park's edge is worn, as the strip malls' are: the ground painted, dirt fading into dry grass out from the paving, no grass strip. Otherwise a grass strip with trees. Industrial car parks are always worn.
zh: 停车场边缘呈现商业街停车场式磨损的概率：绘制地面，从铺装向外由泥土渐变为干草，不设草带。否则设置带树木的草带。工业停车场始终使用磨损边缘。

en: How far the land keeps from water: gardens, yards and car parks stop this far from the shore, along a smooth line. The building's own lot is never cut.
zh: 土地与水体保持的距离：庭院、堆场和停车场沿平滑边界，在距岸边此距离处停止。建筑自身地块不会被裁切。

en: A terraced pit with a haul road spiralling down the benches, stockpiles and plant — or a big flooded dig lake. Permanent terrain change.
zh: 阶梯式矿坑，运输道路沿台阶螺旋下行，配有料堆和机械设备；也可生成大型积水采坑湖。永久改变地形。

en: Working pit, wet lake dig, or an old flooded / abandoned quarry.
zh: 作业矿坑、采挖水塘，或积水／废弃的旧采石场。

en: How much of the space inside the rim the pit takes.
zh: 矿坑占边缘内部空间的比例。

en: Follow the outline, an oval, or a rough organic face.
zh: 顺应轮廓、椭圆形，或粗犷的自然形态。

en: Number of steps down to the floor (fewer when the pit is too narrow).
zh: 通往坑底的台阶数量（矿坑过窄时会减少）。

en: Drop of each step. Total depth = benches × bench height.
zh: 每级台阶的落差。总深度 = 台阶数 × 台阶高度。

en: Width of each ledge (the haul road runs on them).
zh: 每层平台的宽度（运输道路沿平台延伸）。

en: Untouched ground between the outline and the pit, where the yard sits.
zh: 轮廓与矿坑之间保留的原始地面，用于布置场地设施。

en: Steepest change allowed measured from the outline, so the pit always meets the original ground.
zh: 从轮廓起测算所允许的最大坡度，使矿坑始终衔接原地面。

en: Fills the pit with water. A permanent lake.
zh: 向矿坑注水，形成永久湖泊。

en: How far up the pit the water stands; always below the lowest dry bench so it never spills.
zh: 矿坑内的水位高度；始终低于最低的干燥台阶，以防溢出。

en: A fence round the pit edge and danger signs.
zh: 矿坑边缘围栏和危险标志。

en: A ramp road from the gate spiralling down the benches to the floor.
zh: 从大门沿台阶螺旋下行至坑底的坡道。

en: Steepness of the ramp between benches.
zh: 台阶之间坡道的陡峭程度。

en: Crusher and screens by the pit, a site office by the gate (and conveyors on a lake dig).
zh: 矿坑旁的破碎机和筛分机、大门旁的现场办公室（采挖湖还会配有输送带）。

en: A viewpoint with benches on the rim, with a footpath to the outline.
zh: 坑缘设有长椅的观景点，并有步道连接至轮廓。

en: Paints the exposed rock / sand texture over the pit and roads. Permanent.
zh: 在矿坑和道路上绘制裸露岩石／沙地纹理。永久生效。

en: Fallen rocks per hectare at the foot of the bench walls.
zh: 每公顷台阶壁脚的落石数量。

en: Trees and bushes taking over the rim (and the benches of old quarries).
zh: 边缘逐渐蔓生的树木和灌木（旧采石场的台阶上也会生长）。

en: The flooded pit is a permanent lake: removing the quarry keeps the basin and the water.
zh: 积水矿坑是永久湖泊：移除采石场后，湖盆和水体仍会保留。

en: The area is too narrow for a pit inside the rim; only the yard is built.
zh: 区域太窄，无法在边缘内部容纳矿坑；仅建造场地设施。

en: Only {0} of {1} benches fit in this pit.
zh: 此矿坑仅能容纳 {1} 级台阶中的 {0} 级。

en: The pit is too shallow to hold water; it stays dry.
zh: 矿坑太浅，无法蓄水；将保持干燥。

en: A roadside stop: car park, amenity court with restrooms and vending, picnic grove, dog walk and viewpoint.
zh: 路边休息站：停车场、配有厕所和售货设施的服务广场、林间野餐区、遛狗区和观景点。

en: What kind of stop this is. Each type adds its own signature: fuel island, charging lounge, viewpoint…
zh: 休息站的种类。各类型会添加独有设施：加油岛、充电休息区、观景点等。

en: Share of the area used for the car park at the main entrance. 0 = no car park.
zh: 主入口处停车场占区域的比例。0 = 无停车场。

en: Picnic table groups along the footpath.
zh: 人行步道沿线的野餐桌组。

en: Planting in the car park: none, along its edges, or in medians between rows.
zh: 停车场植被：无、沿边缘，或车位排之间的中央绿化带。

en: Long, wide stalls and wider aisles for trucks and coaches.
zh: 供货车和长途客车使用的加长加宽车位，以及更宽的车道。

en: Share of the stalls with a charger.
zh: 配有充电桩的车位比例。

en: Width of the paved amenity court where people step out of the car.
zh: 下车后进入的铺装服务广场宽度。

en: Vending machines along the back of the court.
zh: 沿服务广场后侧布置的自动售货机。

en: A fuel island on the car park side of the court (decorative props).
zh: 服务广场靠停车场一侧的加油岛（装饰道具）。

en: A map / information board at the walk-in point.
zh: 步行入口处的地图／信息板。

en: A small fenced dog run off a branch path, with a bin and a bench.
zh: 支路旁的小型围栏犬只活动区，配有垃圾桶和长椅。

en: A lookout with a bench arc at the far end of the path.
zh: 步道远端的观景点，长椅呈弧形排列。

en: Raise the viewpoint on a mound blended into the ground (permanent terrain change).
zh: 以与地面平滑衔接的土丘抬高观景点（永久改变地形）。

en: A belt of trees along the outline that screens the stop from the road.
zh: 沿轮廓布置树带，将休息站与道路隔开。

en: No room for a car park here; the stop is planned without one.
zh: 此处没有空间容纳停车场；休息站将不设置停车场。

en: How the streets are laid out inside the area.
zh: 区域内部街道的布局方式。

en: Straight streets in a regular grid, aligned with the longest side of the area.
zh: 笔直街道组成规则网格，与区域最长边对齐。

en: A collector along the area with branches ending in pairs of cul-de-sacs.
zh: 一条集散道路穿过区域，两侧伸出分支，分支上再伸出短死胡同。所有过境交通都留在集散道路上。

en: Winding streets with cul-de-sacs and a few loops, like a suburban subdivision.
zh: 郊区住宅区布局：一条主街在两个入口之间蜿蜒穿行，由此伸出弯曲的街道，多数以死胡同结束，部分闭合成环路。

en: Streets follow the terrain's contour lines, linked by gentle uphill roads. Needs sloped terrain.
zh: 街道沿地形等高线布置，几乎保持水平，并由短的上坡街道相连。需要丘陵或斜坡。

en: A radial centre with a roundabout, surrounded by organic streets.
zh: 放射状中心（环岛、大道和环路）被带有尽头路的蜿蜒街道环绕。一条环路连接两者，中心的大道一直延伸到街区中。

en: Widely spaced collectors with a looping local street inside each large block.
zh: 由集散道路连接的本地街道环路，可选择加入死胡同。适合安静的住宅区。

en: Collectors around groups of 3 × 3 blocks with car-free streets inside.
zh: 由道路围合的大街区，内部为步行道网络。让过境交通远离街区。

en: Rings that follow the shape of the area, joined by connecting streets.
zh: 沿所选区域形状分布的环，通过连接道路与中心相连。

en: A central roundabout with straight avenues out to the edge, optionally crossed by circular rings.
zh: 中心设一座环岛，笔直的大道通向边界，并被圆形层横穿。

en: Which road goes where, in one pick. It sets the street, avenue, local, roundabout and perimeter roads and their upgrades below; changing any of them makes it Custom.
zh: 一键选择各处使用的道路。设置下方的街道、大道、支路、环岛和周边道路及其升级；修改任一项后变为自定义。

en: The standard mix: Two-Lane Roads for streets, Four-Lane Roads for avenues, a Two-Lane One-Way Road around roundabouts.
zh: 标准组合：街道使用双车道道路，大道使用四车道道路，环岛使用双车道单行道。
街道：双车道 · 大道：四车道

en: Two-Lane Roads everywhere, even the avenues, with street trees and grass verges. Calm streets for houses.
zh: 所有道路均使用双车道，包括大道，并配有行道树和草地路肩。适合住宅的安静街道。
街道：双车道 + 树木 · 大道：双车道

en: Narrow two-way Alleys between the blocks; Two-Lane Roads for the avenues and the edge.
zh: 街区间使用狭窄双向巷道；大道和周边使用双车道道路。
街道：巷道 · 大道：双车道

en: Pedestrian Streets inside (service vehicles only); cars stay on the Two-Lane avenues and the perimeter road.
zh: 内部使用步行街（仅服务车辆可通行）；汽车仅在双车道大道和周边道路行驶。
街道：步行街 · 大道及周边：双车道

en: Tree-lined Two-Lane streets and divided Four-Lane avenues with trees in the median.
zh: 带行道树的双车道街道，以及中央分隔带植树的四车道大道。

en: Streets: Two-Lane + trees · Avenues: Four-Lane Divided + median trees
zh: 街道：双车道 + 树木 · 大道：分隔式四车道 + 中央树带

en: A busy core: Four-Lane streets, Six-Lane avenues and three-lane one-way roundabout rings.
zh: 繁忙核心区：四车道街道、六车道大道，以及三车道单向环岛。
街道：四车道 · 大道：六车道

en: The standard mix with bike lanes on every street and avenue.
zh: 标准组合，并为每条街道和大道添加自行车道。

en: Streets: Two-Lane + bike lanes · Avenues: Four-Lane + bike lanes
zh: 街道：双车道 + 自行车道 · 大道：四车道 + 自行车道

en: Gravel Roads for villages and farmland; a Two-Lane Road for the through routes and the edge.
zh: 村庄和农田使用碎石路；贯通道路和周边使用双车道道路。
街道：碎石路 · 大道：双车道

en: Your own picks: choose each road below.
zh: 自定义选择：在下方分别选择每种道路。

en: The road for ordinary streets (and the perimeter road unless it has its own pick). Automatic places a Two-Lane Road.
zh: 普通街道使用的道路（周边道路未单独指定时也使用此道路）。自动模式使用双车道道路。

en: The road for cul-de-sacs and short local streets. Automatic uses the street road (a Two-Lane Road by default).
zh: 死胡同和短距离社区街道所用的道路。自动模式使用街道道路（默认为双车道道路）。

en: Dead ends and small side streets.
The road for avenues and collectors, the main lines through the layout. Automatic places a Four-Lane Road.
zh: 大道和集散道路所用的道路，构成布局的主干线。自动模式铺设四车道道路。

en: Wider main roads through the grid.
zh: 贯穿网格的较宽主干道。

en: The one-way road that circles a roundabout island. Automatic places a Two-Lane One-Way Road: two lanes in the ring direction, like the Four-Lane avenue that feeds it. Only used when the layout has roundabouts (Radial, Mixed, Grid avenue crossings).
zh: 环绕环岛中心岛的单行道。自动模式铺设双车道单行道：沿环行方向设置两条车道，与接入的四车道大道相匹配。仅在布局包含环岛时使用（放射式、混合式、网格大道交叉口）。

en: The one-way ring of a roundabout.
The loop around the edge of a drawn or painted area. Automatic uses the street road.
zh: 环绕绘制或涂画区域边缘的道路。自动模式使用街道道路。

en: The road around the edge of the area.
zh: 沿区域边缘环绕的道路。

en: Path used for the walkways and for the car-free streets inside superblocks. Automatic places a Pavement Path (dirt trails take a trail path when your playset has one).
zh: 用于步行通道和超级街区内部无车街道的步道。自动模式铺设铺装步道（若模组播放集中有土路步道，土路小径会使用该步道）。

en: Rotates the layout relative to the longest side of the area.
zh: 在所选区域内旋转样式。

en: Turns the layout so one set of streets follows the slope's contour lines.
zh: 旋转网格，使一个方向的街道沿等高线延伸：这些街道几乎水平，其他街道笔直上坡。角度设置仍会叠加。

en: Size blocks by distance, or by a number of columns and rows that fill the area.
zh: 按距离设置街区尺寸，或以指定列数和行数填满区域。
街道之间使用固定间距。街区数量取决于区域大小。

en: A fixed number of columns and rows spread evenly over the area.
zh: 按下方设置的列数和行数划分所选区域。

en: Number of streets across the area's length.
zh: 沿区域长度方向分布的街道数量。

en: Number of streets across the area's width.
zh: 沿区域宽度方向分布的街道数量。

en: Turns some grid streets into dead ends with a turning circle.
zh: 在网格道路之间添加死胡同。
横跨区域长度方向的街道。
沿区域长度方向的街道。

en: Share of blocks that get a cul-de-sac.
zh: 变为死胡同的街道比例。

en: How far a cul-de-sac reaches into its block.
zh: 每条死胡同的长度，以街区进深的比例表示。

en: Alternates the side cul-de-sacs start from, block after block.
zh: 让死胡同在街道两侧交替排列，而不是排成一线。

en: Decoration placed at the end of every cul-de-sac.
zh: 回车场中央的填充内容。

en: Turning circle with a grass island.
zh: 中央设草地岛的回车场。

en: Turning circle with trees in the middle.
Size of the turning circle. Automatic matches the road width.
zh: 回车场的大小。自动模式与道路宽度匹配。

en: Extra large turning circle (not available in asphalt).
zh: 特大型回车场（不提供沥青材质）。

en: Makes one column of the grid an avenue.
zh: 将网格的一列设为大道。

en: Makes one row of the grid an avenue.
zh: 将网格的一行设为大道。

en: Which column or row becomes the avenue, counted from the first street.
zh: 从第一条街道起计数，指定哪一列或哪一行成为大道。

en: Places a roundabout island where the avenue column and row meet.
zh: 在纵向大道与横向大道交汇处放置环岛中心岛。

en: Distance between two branches on the same side of the collector.
zh: 集散道路同一侧两条分支之间的距离。
每条死胡同的长度。必要时会缩短，使相邻分支的末端与边界保持距离。

en: Distance between two pairs of cul-de-sacs along a branch.
zh: 沿分支两对死胡同之间的距离。
相邻街道之间保持的距离，使两侧都有地块空间。
街道弯曲的程度。为 0% 时街道是直的。

en: Share of branches that join another street instead of ending in a cul-de-sac.
zh: 与另一条街道相连形成环路、而不是以死胡同结束的街道比例。

en: Another random layout with the same settings.
zh: 选择另一种随机布局。相同的数值总是生成相同的布局。

en: Distance between roads that climb from one level street to the next.
zh: 沿等高线街道两条上坡路之间的距离。上坡路坡度不超过 15%。
放射状中心的半径。区域狭窄时中心会缩小或省略。

en: Number of straight avenues leaving the central roundabout.
zh: 从环岛等间距伸出的笔直大道数量。与边界夹角过小的大道会被省略。

en: Distance between collectors; each large block between them gets its own loop.
zh: 连接各环路的集散道路之间的距离。

en: Size of each block inside a superblock.
zh: 超级街区内每个街区的大小。数值越大，街区越少但越大。

en: Number of rings. Fewer are built when the area is too narrow for them.
zh: 形状内部环的数量。最大值取决于所选区域的大小。

en: Number of streets linking the innermost ring outwards.
zh: 从边界到中心连接各环的道路数量。

en: Radius of the central roundabout (reduced to fit the area).
zh: 中央环岛的半径。最小值随大道数量增加，以使路口保持足够间距。

en: A road around the edge of the area that the new streets connect to.
zh: 沿区域边缘布置的道路，新街道会与之连接。

en: On for drawn and painted areas; off for picked blocks, which are already surrounded by roads.
zh: 对绘制或涂画的区域启用；对选取的街区关闭，因为街区周围已有道路。

en: Radius of the perimeter road at the corners of a drawn or painted area. Small keeps the road on your outline (never tighter than the road can turn); the winding styles use more.
zh: 绘制或涂画区域转角处的外围道路半径。较小的值让道路贴合轮廓（不小于道路能实现的转弯半径）；蜿蜒风格采用更大半径。

en: Joins new streets to the roads they meet or cross.
zh: 将新街道接入其遇到或交叉的道路。

en: Leaves out streets that would cross water, buildings or power line pylons, without leaving dead-end stubs.
zh: 省略会穿过水面、建筑或输电塔的街道，且不留下断头残段。

en: Roads follow the ground. Off: the whole network stays at the area's average height.
zh: 道路随地形高度起伏，而不是保持水平。

en: How deep the strips along the new streets reach into each block (used by zoning and other add-ons).
zh: 沿新街道的条带向各街区内部延伸的深度（供分区和其他附加项使用）。

en: Trees along both sides of the streets.
Grass strips along the streets (not with wide sidewalks).
zh: 沿街道设置草带（不能与宽人行道同时使用）。
沿街道设置更宽的人行道。

en: Bike lanes on both sides of the streets.
zh: 在街道两侧设置自行车道。
在中央隔离带上添加树木。
在中央隔离带上添加草地。

en: Trees along both sides of the avenues.
Grass strips along both sides of the avenues.
Bike lanes on both sides of the avenues.
zh: 在大道两侧设置自行车道。

en: No streets fit in this area with these settings. Try a larger area or smaller spacing.
zh: 当前设置下，此区域无法容纳街道。请扩大区域或缩小间距。

en: The terrain here is flat: the contour pattern has no slope to follow.
zh: 该区域过于平坦：没有可以沿着的等高线。请选择丘陵或斜坡上的区域。

en: {0} road segments were left out to avoid water and buildings.
zh: 为避开水面和建筑，已省略 {0} 段道路。

en: The streets could not be planned: {0}
The area outline is not valid.
A street pattern for the area, connected to the roads around it.
zh: 为区域铺设街道布局，并连接周围道路。

en: Streets, with a park filling every block between them.
zh: 铺设街道，并在街道之间的每个街区内填入公园。

en: Streets, with zoning painted along every new street.
zh: 铺设街道，并沿每条新街道涂画分区。

en: Which zone the plots get; buildings of that zone grow there.
zh: 为地块指定分区；该分区的建筑会在此生长。

en: Shops and small businesses (low density commercial).
zh: 商店和小型企业（低密度商业）。

en: Department stores and shop towers (high density commercial).
zh: 百货商店和商业高楼（高密度商业）。

en: Shops on the ground floor with flats above.
zh: 底层为商店，上层为公寓。

en: Apartment blocks of a few storeys.
Set by the Zoning feature: zone the whole cutout, however deep.
zh: 由分区功能设定：无论深度多少，均对整个切分区域划定分区。

en: A specific zone (mods included) instead of the zone type. Cells already zoned keep their zone.
zh: 道路建成后沿新道路自动绘制的分区。只对空格子分区：现有分区和建筑绝不会改变。

en: How deep the zoning reaches from the road (8 m per cell, 6 cells at most).
zh: 分区从道路向内延伸的深度（每格 8 m，最多 6 格）。

en: No road runs along this area, so nothing was zoned.
zh: 此区域边缘没有道路，因此未划定任何分区。

en: On main roads (avenues): side streets join at most this often (m). Closer side streets end in a cul-de-sac before the avenue (with a footpath to it) or join their neighbours instead. 0 = every side street joins.
zh: 主干道（大道）上的支路路口最小间距（m）。距离过近的支路会在大道前形成死胡同（以步道连接大道），或改为连接相邻支路。0 = 所有支路均接入。

en: Footpaths that shorten walks: from cul-de-sacs to the next street or close, through long blocks and through the middle of grid blocks. 0 = none.
zh: 缩短步行距离的步道：从死胡同通向下一条街道或尽端街区，穿过长街区或网格街区中部。0 = 无。

en: Paved footpaths, dirt trails (a trail path when your playset has one, with worn ground painted along it), or a mix.
zh: 铺装步道、土路小径（若播放集中有小径步道则使用，并沿路涂画磨损地面），或两者混合。

en: Dirt or gravel trails with worn ground painted along them (terrain paint is permanent).
zh: 沿线涂画磨损地面的土路或砂砾小径（地形涂画为永久更改）。

en: Small lanes through the middle of the blocks, between two parallel streets (share of the blocks that can take one). Never onto an avenue.
zh: 穿过街区中部、位于两条平行街道之间的小巷（占可设置后巷的街区的比例）。不会接入大道。

en: Paved alleys, gravel lanes, or a mix.
zh: 铺装巷道、砂砾巷道，或两者混合。

en: The Alley road (or the lane road you pick).
zh: 巷道道路（或你选择的巷道道路资产）。
部分铺装巷道，部分砂砾巷道。

en: Road used for back lanes. Automatic places the Alley.
zh: 后巷使用的道路。自动模式铺设巷道。

en: The road of the dead-end streets: the same as their street, gravel, or gravel at some of them.
zh: 断头街道所用的道路：与所在街道相同、全部砂砾，或部分砂砾。

en: Every cul-de-sac is a gravel road from its last junction.
zh: 每条死胡同从最后一个路口起均为砂砾道路。

en: About half of the cul-de-sacs are gravel roads.
zh: 约一半死胡同采用砂砾道路。

en: Follow contours lays the streets along the slope (grids bend onto the contour lines, winding streets steer by the hill, too-steep links go). Ignore terrain keeps the pattern strict whatever the ground does.
zh: 沿等高线布置街道（网格会沿等高线弯曲，蜿蜒街道顺应山势，过陡的连接会被移除）。忽略地形则保持严格布局，不受地面起伏影响。

en: Each pattern as it is (its own Align to terrain option).
zh: 保留各布局自身的设置（各自的“沿地形对齐”选项）。

en: Streets along the contour lines, gentle climbs between them.
zh: 街道沿等高线延伸，以缓坡相互连接。

en: The strict pattern, straight over hills.
zh: 严格遵循布局，笔直跨越山丘。

en: Terraced: on a hill every street's lots are levelled across the street, as deep as their zone cells, with a bank at the back of the lots up to the next level; the banks are painted and planted. Flat ground is never touched. Natural: the ground as it is.
zh: 台地：在山坡上，将每条街道两侧的地块整平至分区网格深度，并在地块后侧设置通向下一层的边坡；边坡会涂画材质并种植。平地不会改动。自然：保持原有地面。

en: Level lots along every street, banks between the levels (sloped ground only).
zh: 整平每条街道旁的地块，在不同高度之间设置边坡（仅用于坡地）。

en: The grade the layout aims to stay under (%). Steeper roads are marked in Design; Follow contours removes too-steep links where it can.
zh: 布局尽量不超过的坡度（%）。更陡的道路会在设计中标出；沿等高线模式会尽可能移除过陡的连接。

en: Zones every cell along every new road with this zone once the roads are built. Cells you zoned before keep their zone.
zh: 道路建成后，沿每条新道路的所有网格涂画此分区。此前已划分区的网格保留原分区。

en: {0} road pieces ({1} m) could not be linked to the rest and were left out.
zh: {0} 段道路（{1} m）无法连接其余路网，已省略。

en: These roads could not be linked to the nearby roads: connect them yourself after building.
zh: 这些道路无法连接附近道路：请在建造后自行连接。

en: A road here climbs {0} %, steeper than the steepest road set for this layout.
zh: 此处道路坡度为 {0} %，超过此布局设置的最大道路坡度。

en: Streets on the hill's contour lines, each on a level terrace as deep as its zone cells, with banks between and links up the slope.
zh: 街道沿山坡等高线延伸，各自位于与分区网格同深的平整台地上，台地之间设边坡，并以上坡道路连接。

en: Zone cells (8 m each) kept level on each side of a terrace street.
zh: 台地街道两侧保持水平的分区网格数（每格 8 m）。

en: How the roads between terraces climb.
zh: 台地之间道路的爬升方式。

en: Straight up where gentle enough, else a long diagonal; switchbacks only where nothing else fits.
zh: 坡度够缓时直接上坡，否则采用较长的斜向道路；仅在其他方式均无法容纳时使用折返路。

en: Zig-zag legs joined by hairpin bends, climbing gently between two terraces.
zh: 以发卡弯连接的之字形路段，在两层台地之间缓慢爬升。

en: One road winding round and up the hill, crossing every terrace.
zh: 一条绕山而上的蜿蜒道路，穿过每一层台地。

en: How far apart the links up the hill are along a terrace street.
zh: 沿台地街道的上坡连接道路间距。

en: The links up the hill are avenues instead of streets.
zh: 上坡连接使用大道而非街道。

en: A gentle cross-fall away from the bank so rain drains off (0 = dead level).
zh: 向远离边坡的一侧设置轻微横坡以排出雨水（0 = 完全水平）。

en: What stands between two levels: rounded grassy banks or steep straight faces.
zh: 两个高度之间的处理方式：圆滑草坡或陡直坡面。

en: A smooth S-shaped bank with rounded edges.
zh: 边缘圆滑的 S 形边坡。

en: A straight steep face with crisp terrace edges, worn dirt on the face.
zh: 平直陡峭的坡面，台地边缘清晰，坡面为磨损土壤。

en: No bank between terraces is steeper than this (50 % = 1 in 2).
zh: 台地之间的边坡不超过此坡度（50 % = 1:2）。

en: Ground already flatter than this is never terraced.
zh: 坡度低于此值的地面不做台地处理。

en: The deepest cut or highest fill the terraces may make.
zh: 台地允许的最大挖深或填高。

en: Dry grass and worn dirt on the banks (terrain paint is permanent).
zh: 在边坡上涂画干草和磨损土壤（地形涂画为永久更改）。

en: Clumps of trees on the banks between the terraces.
zh: 在台地之间的边坡上成丛种树。

en: The hill is steeper than terraces this deep allow: they narrow in places. Fewer cells or a steeper bank fit better.
zh: 山坡过陡，无法容纳此深度的台地：部分位置会变窄。减少网格数或增大边坡坡度会更合适。

en: The earthwork is capped at {0} m: in places the terraces follow the hill a little.
zh: 土方高度限制为 {0} m：部分台地会略微顺应山势。

en: The ground here is flat: the streets are laid in rows and nothing is terraced.
zh: 此处地形平坦：街道将成排铺设，不做台地处理。

en: Street left out: it would cross a building, water or a pylon and no way round fitted.
zh: 街道已省略：会穿过建筑、水面或输电塔，且无法绕行。

en: Perimeter piece left out: a building, water or a pylon sits on the outline and no way round fitted.
zh: 外围路段已省略：轮廓线上有建筑、水面或输电塔，且无法绕行。

en: The perimeter road does not close here: no clean way across the gap.
zh: 外围道路在此处未闭合：无法顺畅跨越缺口。

en: Side street cut back from this main road: junctions here are kept this far apart.
zh: 支路已在此主干道前截短：此处路口需保持该间距。

en: Which existing roads the new streets may join. Roads they may not join are never crossed either.
zh: 新街道允许连接哪些现有道路。不允许连接的道路也不会被跨越。
普通道路（不含高速公路）

en: Every road except highways and their ramps.
zh: 除高速公路及其匝道以外的所有道路。

en: Two-lane roads, lanes and gravel roads only: the big roads keep their junctions few.
zh: 仅双车道道路、巷道和砂砾道路：大型道路保留较少路口。

en: Every road, highways and ramps too.
zh: 所有道路，包括高速公路和匝道。

en: How perfect the grid stays. Strict: every street straight through, whatever the ground. Automatic: the grid gives way where the site asks (it bends on a hill, streets too steep for cars become steps, land too steep to build becomes a hillside park, a diagonal follows a desire line between two city streets when it is worth it). Lively: more of it, with staggered brick blocks and a square in the middle.
zh: 网格保持规整的程度。严格：无论地形如何，每条街道都笔直贯通。自动：根据场地适应调整（山坡上弯曲，过陡而不适合车辆的街道变为阶梯，过陡而无法建造的地块变为山坡公园；有必要时，沿两条城市街道间的通行捷径设置斜向道路）。活泼：调整更多，包含交错砖式街区和中央广场。

en: The plain grid: every street straight through.
zh: 标准网格：每条街道都笔直贯通。

en: The grid gives way to hills and desire lines, only where the site asks for it.
zh: 仅在场地有需要时，网格顺应山势和通行捷径。

en: Staggered brick blocks, a square in the middle, a diagonal along a gentler desire line.
zh: 交错砖式街区、中央广场，以及沿较缓通行捷径布置的斜向道路。

en: Paints the ground the new streets wear in: worn desire paths where people take shortcuts, worn corners at the junctions, dry verges along the streets. Paint stays when the roads are removed.
zh: 涂画新街道带来的地面磨损：行人抄近路形成的踩踏小径、路口磨损角落、街边干枯草带。移除道路后涂画仍会保留。

en: A few desire paths, light wear.
zh: 少量踩踏小径和轻微磨损。
更多踩踏小径和更明显的磨损。

en: A shop plot faces no road the game zones from. It is left to the park.
zh: 商店地块未朝向可划分区的道路，因此交由公园使用。

en: {0} buildings are in the way. They are kept: nothing is built on their lots.
zh: 有 {0} 栋建筑阻挡。它们将保留，其地块上不会建造任何东西。

en: {0} parts were left out or cut back to keep clear of existing buildings.
zh: 为避开现有建筑，已省略或缩减 {0} 个部分。

en: Only things the brush rules keep off are under the paint (buildings, other builds, zoning, water). Paint somewhere else, or change the rules.
zh: 涂画范围内只有笔刷规则排除的对象（建筑、其他建造物、分区、水面）。请换个位置涂画，或更改规则。

en: {0} buildings in the selection stay: nothing is built on their lots.
zh: 选区中的 {0} 栋建筑将保留，其地块上不会建造任何东西。

en: Plain Paint cuts building lots out of the painted area (shaded red while painting). Off = the old behaviour: the outline covers buildings, and the build still leaves them standing.
zh: 普通涂画会从涂画区域中扣除建筑地块（涂画时显示红色阴影）。关闭 = 旧版行为：轮廓覆盖建筑，但建造时仍保留建筑。

en: Needs a bigger area (at least {0} m²).
zh: 需要更大区域（至少 {0} m²）。

en: A fenced yard of scrap: haul loop, material bays, heaps, wrecks, containers or tyres, oily ground and a weighbridge at the gate.
zh: 带围栏的废品场：运输环路、材料隔间、废料堆、报废车辆、集装箱或轮胎、油污地面，以及入口处的地磅。

en: What the yard deals in. Each type has its own layout, not just different props.
zh: 场地经营的废品类型。每种类型都有自己的布局，不只是道具不同。

en: How full the yard is: from a few tidy heaps to every corner crammed.
zh: 场地堆放程度：从少量整齐废料堆到挤满每个角落。

en: Width of the haul loop and the aisles between rows and blocks.
zh: 运输环路及各排、各区之间通道的宽度。

en: Raises real terrain under the big heaps so they read as mountains of scrap. 0 = flat. Permanent.
zh: 抬高大废料堆下的实际地形，使其呈现废料山的体量。0 = 平地。永久更改。

en: Material handlers, loaders, forklifts or reach stackers parked by the heaps and rows.
zh: 停在废料堆和各排旁的抓料机、装载机、叉车或正面吊。

en: Single tyres, drums and bits of scrap lying about near the fence.
zh: 散落在围栏附近的单个轮胎、油桶和废料。

en: Walkable aisles from the gate, for pick-your-own-part yards.
zh: 从大门通入的步行通道，用于自行挑选零件的回收场。

en: Car graveyard: share of the yard left alone long enough for trees and bushes to grow through the wrecks.
zh: 废车场：闲置足够长时间、树木和灌木从废车之间长出的场地比例。

en: A belt of trees just inside the fence that hides the yard from the street.
zh: 围栏内侧的树带，从街道遮挡废品场。

en: Scrubby bushes along the fence and in the corners.
zh: 沿围栏和角落生长的杂灌木。

en: A site cabin beside the way in.
A concrete weighbridge slab across the road just inside the gate.
zh: 紧邻大门内侧、横跨道路的混凝土地磅平台。

en: Paints the terrain texture under heaps and machines (oil-soaked ground). Permanent.
zh: 在废料堆和机械下方涂画地形纹理（油浸地面）。永久更改。

en: Oil, dirt, puddle and crack decals per 100 m², gathered round heaps, machines and roads.
zh: 每 100 m² 的油污、泥土、水洼和裂纹贴花数量，集中在废料堆、机械和道路附近。

en: The yard is too small for a central scrap heap; only the edge bays were filled.
zh: 场地过小，无法容纳中央废料堆；仅填充了边缘隔间。

en: What the piles are made of.
Oil and dirt decals round the foot of each pile.
zh: 每个废品堆底部周围的油污和泥土贴花。

en: A few items that rolled off each pile.
zh: 从各个废品堆滚落的少量物品。

en: Switches itself on when the area is partly in water or runs along it: piers, a filled quay, a promenade or a natural edge along the waterline. Away from water it does nothing.
zh: 当区域部分位于水中或沿水面延伸时自动启用：沿水线设置码头、填土码头岸、滨水步道或自然岸边。远离水面时不生效。

en: Almost all of the area is water, so there is no dry ground left for the shore.
zh: 区域几乎全为水面，没有可用于岸线的陆地。

en: How the waterline is built. Automatic turns the middle into a quay with a pier and the rest into a promenade.
zh: 水线的建造方式。自动模式将中间部分改为带栈桥的码头岸，其余部分改为滨水步道。

en: How deep the shore strip on land is (promenade, quay apron, sand).
zh: 陆地岸边带的深度（滨水步道、码头平台、沙滩）。

en: Joins the waterside walk to the nearest paths of the park or square.
zh: 将滨水步道连接至公园或广场最近的步道。

en: Piers reaching out over the water. They need water inside the area.
zh: 伸入水面的栈桥。需要区域内包含水面。

en: A cross deck at the end of each pier, with benches looking out.
zh: 每座栈桥尽头的横向平台，设有面朝水面的长椅。

en: How far the quay is built out into the water. The water is filled in permanently.
zh: 码头岸向水中延伸的距离。水域会被永久填平。
