en: How much of the shoreline becomes quay.
zh: 岸线改建为码头岸的比例。

en: Boats moored at the quay and the piers, or pulled up on a beach.
zh: 停泊在码头岸和栈桥旁，或被拖上沙滩的船只。

en: Small groups of crates, barrels and nets on the quay.
zh: 码头岸上的小组板条箱、木桶和渔网。

en: Clumps of reeds along the waterline and in the shallows.
zh: 沿水线及浅水处成丛生长的芦苇。

en: Shore: no water in or next to this area, so nothing was built.
zh: 岸线：此区域内部及附近没有水面，因此未建造任何东西。

en: Shore: a quay is built out into water inside the area. Draw the area over the water to get one; a quay edge was made instead.
zh: 岸线：码头岸需向区域内的水面延伸。请将区域绘制到水上；此次改为建造岸边边缘。

en: Shore: piers need water inside the area. Draw the area over the water.
zh: 岸线：栈桥需要区域内包含水面。请将区域绘制到水上。

en: Islands in the open water, raised above it and planted. Fewer fit in a small pond.
zh: 在开阔水面上抬高并种植的岛屿。较小池塘只能容纳较少岛屿。

en: Arched footbridges from each island to the shore and between close islands.
zh: 连接各岛与岸边，以及相邻岛屿之间的拱形人行桥。

en: Fountain jets in the open water.
zh: 开阔水面上的喷泉喷头。

en: A boathouse at the water's edge with a jetty and rowing boats.
zh: 水边带小码头和划艇的船屋。

en: Extra rowing boats out on the water.
zh: 水面上额外放置的划艇。

en: A paved walk all round the water with benches and lamps.
zh: 环绕水面一周的铺装步道，配有长椅和路灯。

en: Joins the promenade, bridges and boathouse to the park's paths.
zh: 将滨水步道、桥梁和船屋连接至公园步道。

en: Pond: too small for a promenade round it.
zh: 池塘：面积过小，无法设置环湖步道。
池塘：{1} 个岛屿中仅能容纳 {0} 个。

en: Pond: no free bank for the boathouse.
zh: 池塘：没有可放置船屋的空闲岸边。
需要 2 个自行车出入口

en: Divides the area: a park on one side, a plaza on the other. Drag the divider or the slider.
zh: 分割区域：一侧为公园，另一侧为广场。拖动分隔线或滑块调整。

en: Click two points on the outline to draw a dividing line (two more for a second line). Without a divider, the sliders decide.
zh: 在轮廓上点击两点绘制分隔线（再点两点可画第二条）。未绘制分隔线时由滑块决定。

en: Share of the area that goes to the first part.
zh: 分配给第一部分的区域比例。

en: 0° cuts across the long side; 90° cuts lengthwise.
zh: 0° 横切长边；90° 沿长度方向切分。

en: Adds a footpath along each dividing line.
zh: 沿每条分隔线添加步道。

en: The area could not be divided this way, so it was kept whole.
zh: 无法按此方式分割区域，因此保留完整区域。

en: A divider needs two points on the outline; the last point is ignored.
zh: 分隔线需要轮廓上的两个点；最后一个点将被忽略。

en: What kind of sports park this is. Presets set it with fitting facilities and landscape.
zh: 运动公园的类型。预设会配好适合的设施和景观。

en: The centrepiece: it takes the best spot with generous room around it, the spectator terrace and the clubhouse. Auto = the biggest field that is on.
zh: 核心设施：占据最佳位置，周围留有充足空间，并配有观众平台和会所。自动 = 已启用的最大运动场。

en: Room between facilities, the tree belt and the paths. Distances also grow with the size of the park.
zh: 设施、树带和步道之间的间隔。距离也会随公园规模增大。

en: Long fields run along the park's longest edge, or north–south / east–west (fewer players blinded by a low sun).
zh: 长形运动场沿公园最长边布置，或按南北／东西方向布置（减少低角度阳光对运动员的干扰）。

en: Pitch format. Auto picks the biggest that leaves room for everything else.
zh: 球场规格。自动选择能为其他设施留出空间的最大规格。

en: Fenced blocks of courts, set shoulder to shoulder.
zh: 带围栏、并排布置的球场组。

en: Courts side by side in one fenced block.
zh: 同一个围栏区域内并排的球场数量。

en: A changing pavilion with toilets behind the spectator terrace, next to the main field.
zh: 主运动场旁、观众平台后方的更衣亭，带卫生间。

en: A paved terrace along the main field with a touchline walk and rows of benches.
zh: 沿主运动场设置的铺装平台，带边线步道和成排长椅。

en: A refreshment kiosk beside the clubhouse.
A jogging loop inside the tree belt, a tree-lined spine from the entrance to the clubhouse, or both.
zh: 树带内侧的慢跑环路、从入口通向会所的林荫主轴，或两者兼有。

en: A paved forecourt at the main entrance with bike racks, a noticeboard and bins.
zh: 主入口处的铺装前庭，配有自行车架、公告牌和垃圾桶。

en: Bike racks on the entrance plaza.
zh: 入口广场上的自行车架。

en: Trees along the outline, outside the promenade loop.
zh: 沿轮廓、位于环形步道外侧的树木。

en: Groves between the facilities: tree groups with open lawn between them.
zh: 设施之间的小树林：树群之间留有开阔草坪。

en: Low planted earth berms in the larger gaps between zones (permanent terrain change).
zh: 在分区之间较大的空隙设置低矮、种植绿化的土堤（永久更改地形）。

en: A tidy car park on the street side next to the main entrance. Auto: only for parks of 2.5 ha or more with road frontage.
zh: 主入口旁临街一侧的整齐停车场。自动：仅用于面积至少 2.5 ha 且临街的公园。

en: Share of the park given to the car park.
zh: 分配给停车场的公园面积比例。

en: What the tennis courts are laid in: hard courts, clay (a club look) or grass.
zh: 网球场的铺装材质：硬地、红土（俱乐部风格）或草地。

en: Click corners. Snaps to curbs, buildings and right angles.
zh: 点击角点。吸附至路缘、建筑和直角。

en: Click a city block to fill it. Shift+click adds more.
zh: 点击城市街区以填充。Shift+点击可添加更多街区。

en: Brush it on, freely (Smart edges off). Right-click erases.
zh: 自由涂画（关闭智能边缘）。右键擦除。

en: Click road corners around the area; the roads between are followed.
zh: 点击区域周围的道路转角；沿转角之间的道路生成边界。

en: Brush it on; it stops at roads, buildings, zoning and water (Smart edges). Right-click erases.
zh: 涂画区域，并在道路、建筑、分区和水面前停止（智能边缘）。右键擦除。

en: Join up the gardens of the houses you pick, or put them back as the game made them.
zh: 连接所选住宅的庭院，或将其恢复为游戏原样。

en: Outgrowing the whole city, a few buildings at a time
zh: 正在逐批扩展全市庭院，每次处理少量建筑

en: Removing outgrow from the whole city, a few hundred at a time
zh: 正在逐批移除全市庭院扩展，每次处理数百栋建筑

en: Outgrow is switched off for this city: they outgrow once you switch it back on
zh: 此城市已关闭庭院扩展：重新启用后，它们的庭院才会扩展
当前没有正在建造的项目

en: That is the most corners an outline can have.
zh: 轮廓角点数量已达上限。

en: An area needs at least three corners.
zh: 区域至少需要三个角点。

en: Too small for this design (at least {0} m²).
zh: 对此设计而言过小（至少 {0} m²）。

en: Too large for this design (at most {0} m²).
zh: 对此设计而言过大（最多 {0} m²）。

en: This outline lies on another Placemaker build. Move it, or turn off the brush rule "Other builds".
zh: 此轮廓覆盖了其他 Placemaker 建造物。请移动轮廓，或关闭笔刷规则中的“其他建造物”。

en: No block could be found here.
Nothing to paint in this block: it is zoned, built on or under water.
zh: 此街区没有可涂画的区域：已划分区、已有建筑或位于水下。

en: Nothing can be painted here: it is a road, zoned, built on or under water.
zh: 此处无法涂画：属于道路、已划分区、已有建筑或位于水下。

en: No roads nearby. Use Draw or Paint here.
zh: 附近没有道路。请在此使用绘制或涂画。

en: Not enclosed here. Turn on more walls (paths, tracks…) or use Points.
zh: 此处未围合。请启用更多边界（步道、轨道…），或使用点选。

en: This block is too large to pick. Use Draw or Paint.
zh: 此街区过大，无法选取。请使用绘制或涂画。

en: Only blocks next to the selection can be added.
zh: 只能添加与选区相邻的街区。

en: Areas cannot have holes: that would enclose a block you did not pick.
zh: 区域不能有孔洞：这会围住未选取的街区。

en: Removing that block would split the selection in two.
zh: 移除此街区会将选区一分为二。

en: The loop is closed. Right-click to reopen it.
zh: 环路已闭合。右键可重新打开。

en: These intersections are not connected by roads.
zh: 这些交叉口之间没有道路连接。

en: The loop already passes through there.
The design could not be saved.
Only your own designs can be deleted.
zh: 只能删除你自己的设计。

en: The preset could not be saved.
Only your own presets can be renamed.
zh: 只能重命名你自己的预设。

en: This area cannot be edited (its design was not stored).
zh: 无法编辑此区域（未保存其设计）。

en: Click elsewhere to fill there instead
zh: 点击其他位置以改为填充该处
建造完成！请选择下一个区域。
建造完成，有 {0} 条提示（显示在地图上）。

en: Saved as the default for this layer.
zh: 已保存为此图层的默认设置。

en: Ungrouped: click its pieces one by one.
zh: 已取消组合：现在可以逐个点击其中的部件。

en: Grouped again: one click selects all of it.
zh: 已重新组合：点击一次即可选中整体。

en: The layout could not be planned: {0}
Planning took longer than {0} s and was stopped. Try a smaller area.
zh: 规划耗时超过 {0} s，已停止。请尝试缩小区域。

en: The area was trimmed to keep off existing roads ({0} m² left out).
zh: 为避开现有道路，已裁剪区域（排除 {0} m²）。

en: A road runs through the area: the largest part is used, {0} smaller part(s) ({1} m²) left out. Select them separately if you want them too.
zh: 有道路穿过区域：使用最大部分，省略 {0} 个较小部分（{1} m²）。若也需要它们，请分别选择。

en: Red circles show where it went wrong. Adjust the outline or the settings and build again, or go back. The circles disappear as soon as you change something.
zh: 红圈标出出错位置。请调整轮廓或设置后重新建造，或返回。更改任意内容后红圈便会消失。

en: Reshapes the ground (about {0} m²). This stays even if you remove the build later.
zh: 将重塑地面（约 {0} m²）。之后即使移除建造物，地形仍会保留。

en: Digs a pond or lake (about {0} m²). The hollow stays even if you remove the build later.
zh: 将挖掘池塘或湖泊（约 {0} m²）。之后即使移除建造物，凹地仍会保留。

en: On: outgrown buildings' gardens join up with their neighbours: one plot each, shared fences and hedges, lawns or painted ground up to them, planting, paths and garden features by theme. Off: nothing is changed from now on; gardens already outgrown stay as they are (Remove all outgrow puts them back). Switching it on never redoes the whole city.
zh: 开启：扩展后的建筑庭院会与相邻庭院衔接；各有一个地块，共享围栏和树篱，草坪或涂画地面延伸至边界，并按主题布置植物、步道和庭院设施。关闭：此后不再更改；已扩展的庭院保持现状（“移除全部庭院扩展”可恢复）。开启此项不会重做全市庭院。

en: How many buildings in this city are outgrown, and what is still being worked on. Changing a setting below never changes the whole city at once: new buildings get it, the painter (Outgrow gardens in Placemaker) gives it to an area, and Redo outgrown buildings gives it to every outgrown building, a few at a time.
zh: 此城市已扩展庭院的建筑数量，以及仍在处理的内容。更改下方设置不会立即改变全市：新建筑采用新设置，涂画工具（Placemaker 中的“庭院扩展”）可应用至某区域，“重做已扩展庭院”则分批应用至所有已扩展庭院的建筑。

en: Open a city to see how many buildings are outgrown.
zh: 打开城市以查看已扩展庭院的建筑数量。
已扩展 {0:N0}/{1:N0} 栋建筑的庭院

en: working through {0:N0}, a few at a time

zh: 庭院扩展已关闭：不会更改

en: settings changed: new buildings get them, Redo outgrown buildings gives them to the rest
zh: 设置已更改：新建筑会采用新设置，“重做已扩展庭院”可应用至其余建筑

en: Outgrows every house, shop, office and works already standing in this city (not the kinds set to Off), each with its kind's theme. It runs in the background a few buildings at a time, so the game keeps running smoothly; in a big city it takes a few minutes. Remove all outgrow puts it back.
zh: 对城市中所有现有住宅、商店、办公楼和工业建筑进行庭院扩展（已关闭的类型除外），各自使用对应类型的主题。后台逐批处理少量建筑，确保游戏流畅；大城市可能需要几分钟。“移除全部庭院扩展”可恢复。

en: Outgrow every building in this city? It runs in the background a few buildings at a time; in a big city it can take several minutes.
zh: 扩展此城市所有建筑的庭院？将在后台逐批处理少量建筑；大城市可能需要几分钟。

en: Fits every outgrown building again with the settings above and gives it its kind's theme (buildings you gave a theme with the painter keep it). It runs in the background a few buildings at a time.
zh: 根据上方设置重新调整所有已扩展庭院的建筑，并采用其类型对应的主题（通过涂画工具指定过主题的建筑保留原主题）。后台逐批处理少量建筑。

en: Redo every outgrown building with these settings? It runs in the background a few buildings at a time; in a big city it can take several minutes.
zh: 使用这些设置重做所有已扩展庭院？将在后台逐批处理少量建筑；大城市可能需要几分钟。

en: Buildings that grow from now on are outgrown, each with its kind's theme below. Off: they stay as the game made them. Buildings already standing: Outgrow every building below, or Outgrow gardens in Placemaker for an area.
zh: 今后生成的建筑将扩展庭院，各自使用下方对应类型的主题。关闭：保持游戏原样。对于已有建筑，可使用下方的“扩展所有建筑庭院”，或通过 Placemaker 的“庭院扩展”处理某区域。

en: Puts every garden in this city back as the game made it: fences, hedges and lawns go back, and the beds, paths, bushes and paving that outgrow added are taken away. Ground paint stays. It runs in the background a few hundred buildings at a time.
zh: 将此城市所有庭院恢复为游戏原样：恢复围栏、树篱和草坪，移除庭院扩展添加的花坛、步道、灌木及铺装。地面涂画保留。后台逐批处理数百栋建筑。

en: Put every garden in this city back as the game made it? It runs in the background a few hundred buildings at a time.
zh: 将此城市所有庭院恢复为游戏原样？将在后台逐批处理数百栋建筑。

en: How the gardens of homes are dressed when they are outgrown. Garden: lawns, beds, now and then a sand pit or a bench. Natural: painted ground instead of lawn, rock outcrops, logs, meadow. Tidy: lawns, hedges and flower beds, no rocks. Yard: worn ground, rubble, pallets and crates. Off: new homes are not outgrown. The painter can give any house its own theme. A change is given to homes outgrown from now on; Redo outgrown buildings gives it to the ones already outgrown.
zh: 住宅庭院扩展后的布置方式。花园：草坪、花坛，偶尔有沙坑或长椅。自然：用涂画地面代替草坪，配有露岩、原木和草甸。整洁：草坪、树篱和花坛，不含岩石。堆场：磨损地面、碎石、托盘和板条箱。关闭：不扩展新住宅庭院。涂画工具可为任意住宅指定独立主题。更改应用于此后扩展的住宅；“重做已扩展庭院”可应用至已扩展的住宅。

en: How shops are dressed when outgrown (the gaps between them are paved with their own paving whatever the theme). Off: new shops are not outgrown. A change is given to shops outgrown from now on; Redo outgrown buildings gives it to the ones already outgrown.
zh: 商店庭院扩展后的布置方式（无论主题如何，商店之间的空隙均使用其自身铺装填充）。关闭：不扩展新商店庭院。更改应用于此后扩展的商店；“重做已扩展庭院”可应用至已扩展的商店。

en: How offices are dressed when outgrown. Off: new offices are not outgrown. A change is given to offices outgrown from now on; Redo outgrown buildings gives it to the ones already outgrown.
zh: 办公楼庭院扩展后的布置方式。关闭：不扩展新办公楼庭院。更改应用于此后扩展的办公楼；“重做已扩展庭院”可应用至已扩展的办公楼。

en: How industry is dressed when outgrown: Yard gives storage yards, rubble and worn ground. Off: new industry is not outgrown. A change is given to industry outgrown from now on; Redo outgrown buildings gives it to the ones already outgrown.
zh: 工业建筑庭院扩展后的布置方式：“堆场”提供储料场、碎石和磨损地面。关闭：不扩展新工业建筑庭院。更改应用于此后扩展的工业建筑；“重做已扩展庭院”可应用至已扩展的工业建筑。

en: A garden's lawn grows to its new fences, around driveways and paving. Off: only the fences and hedges are joined.
zh: 庭院草坪绕过车道和铺装，延伸至新围栏。关闭：只连接围栏和树篱。

en: How many gardens are painted (lush ground with soft edges) instead of keeping lawns: their own grass is tucked away and the whole garden is painted, paving kept. Natural and Yard buildings are painted more often, Tidy ones seldom; 0 never, 100 always. A mix looks more like a real street.
zh: 采用涂画地面（边缘柔和的茂密草地）替代草坪的庭院比例：收起原有草坪，涂画整个庭院，保留铺装。自然和堆场主题更常使用涂画，整洁主题较少使用；0 为从不，100 为始终。混合效果更像真实街道。

en: Shops, offices and works fill the land between them with the surface most of their ground already is (their car park or concrete), not lawn.
zh: 商店、办公楼和工业建筑之间的土地，用其现有地面占比最大的材质（停车场或混凝土）填充，而非草坪。

en: Planted beds with bushes along some of the new fences and hedges. They belong to the house and go with it.
zh: 沿部分新围栏和树篱设置带灌木的种植花坛。它们归属于住宅，并随住宅一同移除。

en: Big new garden land gets something in it now and then: a rock garden, a sand pit, a wild corner with logs, or a bench with a flower bed. Next to industry, a storage yard with rubble, pallets and crates.
zh: 较大的新增庭院偶尔会增加一些景物：岩石花园、沙坑、带原木的野趣角落，或配花坛的长椅。工业建筑旁则设置带碎石、托盘和板条箱的储料场。

en: A paved path through some big gardens, and a walkway between some houses with a narrow gap.
zh: 在部分大庭院内设置铺装步道，并在间隔较窄的部分住宅之间设置步行通道。

en: Now and then a rock by the street where two gardens meet (never against a hedge).
zh: 偶尔在两座庭院相接的临街位置放置岩石（不会紧贴树篱）。

en: Soft lush ground past the gardens' edges, blending them into the land around, and worn ground along fences that face open land. Paint stays on the ground when a house is bulldozed.
zh: 在庭院边缘外涂画柔和的茂密草地，使其融入周围环境，并沿朝向空地的围栏涂画磨损地面。住宅拆除后，地面涂画仍会保留。
涂画区域：关闭智能边缘

en: Paint area paints over roads, buildings, zoning and water, ignoring the stops below.
zh: 区域涂画覆盖道路、建筑、分区和水面，忽略下方的停止规则。

en: The brush stops at the curb and never paints across a road.
zh: 笔刷在路缘处停止，绝不跨越道路涂画。

en: The brush keeps off building lots.
Every area tool keeps off what you built with Placemaker (except the one being edited).
zh: 所有区域工具均避开用 Placemaker 建造的对象（正在编辑的对象除外）。

en: The brush keeps off parks, other mods' lots and lot areas.
zh: 笔刷避开公园、其他模组的场地和地块区域。

en: The brush keeps off zoned cells that have a building (or one being built). Vacant zoned land stays paintable.
zh: 笔刷避开已有建筑（或正在建造建筑）的分区网格。空置的已划分区土地仍可涂画。
遇所有已划分区网格停止

en: The brush also keeps off zoned cells nobody has built on yet.
zh: 笔刷也避开尚未建造的已划分区网格。

en: The brush also keeps the empty zone grid free.
zh: 笔刷也保留空白分区网格。

en: The brush keeps off water deeper than wading depth.
zh: 笔刷避开超过涉水深度的水面。

en: A Paint area stroke stays inside the block where it started.
zh: 一次区域涂画笔画只在起始街区内生效。

en: Points, Paint bucket and Road nodes outlines are cut back to free land using the stops above.
zh: 根据上方停止规则，将点选、填充桶和道路节点的轮廓裁剪至空地。

en: Painted edges this close to a curb or obstacle snap onto it; 0 = off.
zh: 涂画边缘距离路缘或障碍物小于此值时吸附至其上；0 = 关闭。

en: How smooth the painted edge is: 0 keeps the brush cells, 6 is smoothest.
zh: 涂画边缘的平滑程度：0 保留笔刷网格，6 最平滑。

en: Puts every edge rule back to its default.
zh: 将所有边缘规则恢复为默认值。

en: Removes trees, plants, props and decals inside the area when it is built, so nothing old pokes through. Buildings, utilities and roads are never touched.
zh: 建造时移除区域内的树木、植物、道具和贴花，避免旧物穿出。绝不改动建筑、公用设施和道路。
防止分区建筑占用建造物

en: Blocks the roads' zone cells under a park, plaza or other build (except its zoning cutouts), so the city cannot grow houses or shops on it. Removing the build unblocks them again. Off: the land under a build stays zonable.
zh: 封锁公园、广场或其他建造物下方的道路分区网格（其分区切分区域除外），防止城市在其上生成住宅或商店。移除建造物后恢复网格。关闭：建造物下方土地仍可划分区。
修复或跳过被拒绝的部件

en: If the game refuses some pieces, repair or leave out just those and build the rest. Placemaker tells you what was skipped.
zh: 若游戏拒绝部分部件，仅修复或省略这些部件，其余正常建造。Placemaker 会说明跳过的内容。

en: Paving, asphalt and plaza surfaces are drawn on top of grass instead of flickering with it.
zh: 铺装、沥青和广场表面显示在草地之上，避免重叠闪烁。

en: Leaves, stains and other ground decals lie under trees, benches and paths instead of being hidden where they overlap. Turn off if decals do not show.
zh: 落叶、污渍和其他地面贴花可位于树木、长椅和步道下方，不因重叠而隐藏。若贴花不显示，请关闭此项。

en: Roads and paths cost what the game charges for them, like when you draw them yourself.
zh: 道路和步道按游戏正常价格收费，与手动绘制时相同。

en: Select and bulldoze as one thing
Clicking any part of a built lot, park or plaza selects the whole build; bulldozing removes it all. Applies to new builds.
zh: 点击已建场地、公园或广场的任意部分会选中整个建造物；拆除时全部移除。适用于新建造物。

en: After every build, writes the terrain heights before and after, the water depth and the built paths and objects around it to ModsData/Placemaker/debug as a JSON file, for checking the result offline (the gallery renders it). Off normally.
zh: 每次建造后，将建造前后的地形高度、水深及周围已建步道和对象以 JSON 文件写入 ModsData/Placemaker/debug，用于离线检查结果（图库会渲染它）。通常关闭。

en: Ask before bulldozing a whole build
zh: 拆除整个建造物前询问

en: Shows the game's confirmation before a Placemaker build is bulldozed.
zh: 拆除 Placemaker 建造物前显示游戏确认框。

en: Only when collisions are not ignored: decorative pieces the game refuses are left out (listed in the build report) instead of refusing the whole build.
zh: 仅在未忽略碰撞时生效：省略游戏拒绝的装饰部件（在建造报告中列出），而非拒绝整个建造项目。
忽略我的建造物中的碰撞

en: Build everything you planned, like the Anarchy mod: the game's overlap and shape checks never refuse or remove pieces of a Placemaker build. Existing buildings are never demolished.
zh: 像 Anarchy 模组一样建造所有规划内容：游戏的重叠和形状检查不会拒绝或移除 Placemaker 建造物的部件。绝不拆除现有建筑。

en: Lets planned ground surfaces show on top of road decals where they meet.
zh: 使规划的地面表面在与道路贴花相接处显示于贴花上方。
预览中显示纹理表面（实验性）

en: Shows ground surfaces in the 3D preview with their real texture. Changes how the game batches surfaces for rendering; off by default until verified stable.
zh: 在 3D 预览中显示地面表面的真实纹理。会改变游戏对表面进行批量渲染的方式；确认稳定前默认关闭。

en: Parking lots built with Placemaker charge a parking fee and count as parking in the city.
zh: Placemaker 建造的停车场收取停车费，并计入城市停车设施。
停车场服务建筑（实验性）

en: Adds an invisible service building to parking lots so they show up in city statistics. Experimental.
zh: 为停车场添加不可见的服务建筑，使其出现在城市统计中。实验性功能。

en: Multiplies the upkeep of the parking lot service building.
zh: 乘以停车场服务建筑的维护费用。

en: Show what a click does and the area size next to the cursor.
zh: 在光标旁显示点击操作说明和区域大小。

en: Simple updates the preview when you let go of a slider or corner and hides small objects; Detailed updates continuously.
zh: 简洁模式在松开滑块或角点后更新预览，并隐藏小型对象；详细模式持续更新。

en: Corners snap to the edges of nearby roads. The other snapping options are in the game's snapping menu.
zh: 角点吸附至附近道路边缘。其他吸附选项位于游戏的吸附菜单中。

en: The sketch preview shades planned grass, paving and water with a faint tint. Turn off to see only their outlines.
zh: 草图预览用浅色标示规划的草地、铺装和水面。关闭后仅显示轮廓。

en: Drawn and painted areas stop at the edge of existing roads and sidewalks, so nothing is planned on the asphalt. Entrances move to the new edge.
zh: 绘制和涂画的区域在现有道路及人行道边缘停止，避免规划内容落在沥青路面上。入口会移动至新边缘。

en: Scales the layout of every area type: path loops, spacing between benches and trees, plaza and feature sizes, margins. Trees, props and path widths keep their real size; parking stalls, roads, sports fields and golf greens keep real dimensions. 50% is the default; 100% is the original, roomier layout.
zh: 缩放所有区域类型的布局：步道环路、长椅和树木间距、广场和特色设施尺寸、边距。树木、道具和步道宽度保持实际大小；停车位、道路、运动场和高尔夫果岭保持实际尺寸。默认 50%；100% 为原始、更宽敞的布局。

en: The one gap (in metres at 100% layout size) kept between the outline and paths or layout. Objects still keep their own footprint clear of the edge.
zh: 轮廓与步道或布局之间保留的统一间隙（按 100% 布局尺寸时的米数计算）。对象仍会按自身占地范围避开边缘。

en: How strongly the zone grid shows while zoning or building roads: empty cells and zoned cells alike. 100% is the game's own look; lower makes it fainter, 0% hides it.
zh: 划分区或建造道路时，空白网格和已划分区网格的显示强度。100% 为游戏原样；较低值更淡，0% 隐藏。

en: Opens or closes the Placemaker tool.
zh: 打开或关闭 Placemaker 工具。

en: Does what the main button says (next step, build…).
zh: 执行主按钮所示操作（下一步、建造…）。

en: Undo the last change to the area or design.
zh: 撤销对区域或设计的上一次更改。
恢复 Placemaker 默认快捷键。
移除 Placemaker 建造的所有内容

en: Removes every park, plaza, parking lot and road area built with Placemaker in this city.
zh: 移除此城市中所有由 Placemaker 建造的公园、广场、停车场和道路区域。

en: Remove everything Placemaker built in this city? This cannot be undone.
zh: 移除此城市中 Placemaker 建造的所有内容？此操作无法撤销。

en: Resets these options and forgets the layer defaults you saved.
zh: 重置这些选项，并清除你保存的图层默认设置。

en: Reset all Placemaker options and saved layer defaults?
zh: 重置所有 Placemaker 选项和已保存的图层默认设置？

en: Ground paint, about {0} m² — stays if the build is removed.
zh: 地面涂画，约 {0} m²——移除建造物后仍保留。

en: The bucket needs a line wall: turn on Roads, Paths, Bike paths or Rail.
zh: 填充桶需要线状边界：请开启道路、步道、自行车道或铁路。

en: Only walls here (water, lots or zoning). Click open land.
zh: 此处只有边界（水面、地块或分区）。请点击空地。

en: The gap closes itself (dashed); Next to go on
zh: 缺口会自动闭合（虚线）；点击“下一步”继续

en: Every car road (alleys, gravel, one-way, pedestrian streets) bounds the bucket's fill.
zh: 所有汽车道路（巷道、砂砾路、单行道、步行街）均限制填充桶的填充范围。

en: Pedestrian paths split blocks like streets do.
zh: 人行步道像街道一样分割街区。

en: Bicycle-only paths split blocks like streets do.
zh: 自行车专用道像街道一样分割街区。

en: Paint bucket walls: rail and tram
zh: 填充桶边界：铁路和有轨电车

en: Train and tram tracks at ground level split blocks.
zh: 地面铁路和有轨电车轨道分割街区。

en: The fill stops at the water's edge and keeps the side you clicked.
zh: 填充在水边停止，保留你点击的一侧。

en: Paint bucket walls: lots and buildings
zh: 填充桶边界：地块和建筑

en: The fill stops at buildings, other lots and your other builds, keeping the side you clicked.
zh: 填充在建筑、其他地块及你的其他建造物处停止，保留你点击的一侧。

en: The fill stops at zoned cells, keeping the side you clicked.
zh: 填充在已划分区网格处停止，保留你点击的一侧。

en: That spot is a road or something else it stops at. Click the land next to it.
zh: 该位置是道路或其他会阻止填充的对象。请点击旁边的土地。

en: Too small to fill here. Lower Gaps to reach narrow places.
zh: 此处过小，无法填充。降低“缺口”值以覆盖狭窄位置。

en: On a road node: two in a row follow the road
zh: 位于道路节点：连续两点沿道路走向连接

en: Points, Paint bucket and Paint area keep off footpaths.
zh: 点选、填充桶和区域涂画避开人行步道。

en: Points, Paint bucket and Paint area keep off bike paths.
zh: 点选、填充桶和区域涂画避开自行车道。

en: Stop at rail and tram tracks
zh: 遇铁路和有轨电车轨道停止

en: Points, Paint bucket and Paint area keep off train and tram tracks on the ground.
zh: 点选、填充桶和区域涂画避开地面铁路和有轨电车轨道。

en: Openings narrower than this count as closed for the Paint bucket and Paint area's One block, and places narrower than it are left out. 0 = off.
zh: 对填充桶和区域涂画的“单一街区”功能，小于此宽度的开口视为闭合，宽度小于此值的位置也会排除。0 = 关闭。

en: How far the Paint bucket spreads from where you click. In open land it fills a circle this size.
zh: 填充桶从点击位置扩展的距离。在空地上会填充此大小的圆形区域。

en: Where bus, taxi, bike and car meet: bays on the kerb, shelters, bike racks, park & ride and a forecourt.
zh: 公交、出租车、自行车和汽车的交汇点：路缘停靠位、候车亭、自行车架、停车换乘及前庭。

en: What the plaza is mainly for. Each type adds its own signature: car park, bike rows, taxi rank, centrepiece…
zh: 广场的主要用途。各类型添加专属特色：停车场、自行车停放排、出租车候车区、中心景物…

en: Share of the area used for a park & ride car park at one end of the frontage. 0 = none.
zh: 在临街面一端用于停车换乘停车场的面积比例。0 = 无。

en: Spaces in the taxi rank on the kerb lane.
zh: 路缘车道上出租车候车区的车位。

en: Kiss & ride spaces for a quick stop on the kerb lane.
zh: 路缘车道上供快速停车接送的车位。

en: Length of each bus bay: 12 m for a standard bus, 18 m or more for articulated buses.
zh: 每个公交停靠位的长度：标准公交车 12 m，铰接公交车 18 m 或以上。

en: A row of bollards between the kerb lane and the plaza.
zh: 路缘车道与广场之间的一排隔离柱。

en: Bike racks in rows near the kerb, five to a row.
zh: 靠近路缘成排放置的自行车架，每排五个。

en: A roof over each row of bike racks.
zh: 每排自行车架上方的顶棚。

en: A bike repair / service kiosk next to the racks.
zh: 自行车架旁的自行车维修／服务亭。

en: Wayfinding boards at the entrances and by the centre.
zh: 入口处和中心附近的导向指示牌。

en: A clock, statue or monument at the focal point opposite the kerb.
zh: 路缘对面的视觉焦点处放置时钟、雕像或纪念碑。

en: Trees in a regular grid, in rows away from the street, or in islands with benches.
zh: 树木按规则网格、远离街道的成排行列，或带长椅的绿化岛布置。

en: Click corners, then the first one
zh: 点击角点，再点击首个角点
拖动涂画，右键拖动擦除

en: Over a junction a corner snaps to the road node; two in a row follow the road. Alt: no snapping.
zh: 在交叉口上，角点会吸附至道路节点；连续两点沿道路走向连接。Alt：不吸附。

en: Repeats in this order along the edges

On: it is built as one asset. Click it to select all of it; the bulldozer removes all of it. Off: built as separate pieces you click, change and bulldoze one at a time. Removing all of it then takes Remove in a piece's info panel. You can ungroup or group it again later from there.
zh: 开启：建造为一个整体资产。点击即可选中整体，使用推土机可将其整体拆除。关闭：建造为独立部件，可逐个点击、修改和拆除。如需全部移除，请使用任一部件信息面板中的“移除”。之后也可以在该面板中取消组合或重新组合。
保留此区域的选中状态

en: On: after building, the area stays selected and Placemaker stays open, so you can build something else there. Off: Build closes Placemaker.
zh: 开启：建造后保持此区域选中，并保持 Placemaker 面板打开，方便在此继续建造其他内容。关闭：建造后关闭 Placemaker 面板。

en: No room for it in this area.
zh: 此区域没有空间容纳它。
{1} 个位置中有 {0} 个可容纳。

en: Make the area bigger or turn other extras off.
zh: 请扩大区域，或关闭其他额外设施。

en: Some assets it used are missing (a mod or asset pack was removed). Edit to replace them.
zh: 使用的部分资产缺失（某个模组或资产包已移除）。请编辑以替换。

en: Changed with other tools since it was built. Editing rebuilds it from its design.
zh: 建造后曾被其他工具修改。编辑会根据原设计重建。

en: Remove all of it? Buildings that grew next to it stay.
zh: 要全部移除吗？附近自然生长的建筑会保留。

en: Ungroup it? Its pieces are then clicked and bulldozed one at a time. Group again puts it back.
zh: 要取消组合吗？取消后可逐个点击和拆除其中的部件。使用“重新组合”可恢复为整体。

en: Ungrouped: you click and bulldoze its pieces one at a time. Remove takes all of it.
zh: 已取消组合：现在可逐个点击和拆除其中的部件。使用“移除”可将其全部移除。

en: Choose an area and turn it into a park, plaza, parking lot, streets… or your own mix.
zh: 选择区域，将其变成公园、广场、停车场、街道…或你自己的组合。

en: Show every layer as it was
Hover: show only this on the map. Click: hide it.
zh: 悬停：地图上仅显示此图层。点击：隐藏。

en: Hidden on the map. Click to show it.
zh: 已在地图上隐藏。点击以显示。

en: Click to let Randomize change it again.
zh: 点击以允许随机化再次更改此值。

en: This was built by an older version and can only be removed.
zh: 此对象由旧版本建造，只能移除。

en: Click something you built to edit it
zh: 点击已建造的对象以编辑

en: One thing again: a click selects all of it and the bulldozer removes all of it.
zh: 恢复为整体：点击即可选中整体，使用推土机可将其整体拆除。

en: Everything Placemaker built here (paths, surfaces, objects, roads it added) is bulldozed. Buildings that grew next to it stay.
zh: 拆除此处 Placemaker 建造的所有内容（步道、表面、对象及新增道路）。旁边生成的建筑会保留。

en: Its pieces become separate: click any tree, bench, path or surface to change it or bulldoze it on its own. The bulldozer then removes one piece at a time, so removing all of it gets hard: use Remove in a piece's info panel for that. You can group it again there.
zh: 各个部件将独立存在：点击任意树木、长椅、步道或地表，即可单独修改或拆除。此时推土机每次只能拆除一个部件，全部拆除较为繁琐；如需全部移除，请使用任一部件信息面板中的“移除”。也可以在该面板中重新组合。

en: Make its pieces separate, so you can click, change and bulldoze each one yourself.
zh: 将各个部件分开，以便逐个点击、修改和拆除。

en: A small road junction through the edge.
zh: 穿过边缘的小型道路连接口。

en: Cars drive in and out here.
zh: 车辆可在此驶入和驶出。

en: Placing {0} — click on the outline. Right-click one to remove it.
zh: 正在放置 {0}——点击轮廓。右键点击标记可移除。

en: On: a crosswalk across the street here. Off: the path stops at the sidewalk.
zh: 开启：在此处设置横穿街道的人行横道。关闭：步道止于人行道。

en: On: the entrances you place next get a crosswalk across the street (the path joins the road at a new junction). Off: the path stops at the sidewalk and the game joins it, with no crosswalk and no cut in the road. Each placed entrance has its own switch below.
zh: 开启：接下来放置的入口会设置横穿街道的人行横道（步道通过新建路口接入道路）。关闭：步道止于人行道，由游戏自动连接，不设置人行横道，也不分割道路。每个已放置的入口都可以通过下方各自的开关单独设置。

en: Click the outline to add; right-click one to remove.
zh: 点击轮廓以添加；右键点击标记以移除。
添加 {0} 个入口以建造

en: Pick a type, then click the outline by a road.
zh: 选择类型，再点击道路旁的轮廓。

en: Click the outline by a road to place one. Right-click removes one. Esc when done.
zh: 点击道路旁的轮廓线以放置入口。右键点击入口可将其移除。完成后按 Esc。

en: Planning took too long and was stopped.
The whole city's outgrow: each zone type's default, the brush, the map lens, the outgrow types and their numbers.
zh: 全市庭院扩展：各分区类型的默认设置、笔刷、地图视图、庭院扩展类型及数量。

en: Make roads, parks, car parks, shops and zones in an area you pick.
zh: 在所选区域内建造道路、公园、停车场、商店和分区。

en: Drag to move. Double-click to dock.
zh: 拖动以移动。双击以停靠。

en: No settings: adapts to the area.

zh: 区域内 {0} 栋建筑 · {1} 栋已扩展庭院
绿色：已扩展庭院的建筑

en: Each building gets its zone type's outgrow type (Outgrow, its Defaults)
zh: 每栋建筑采用其分区类型对应的庭院扩展类型（“庭院扩展”中的“默认设置”）

en: The game uses this value for the build.
zh: 游戏使用此数值作为建造物的属性。

en: Draws tourists: adds to your city's tourism attractiveness.
zh: 吸引游客：增加城市的旅游吸引力。

en: How many nearby streets the park can serve before it gets crowded.
zh: 公园在变得拥挤之前可服务的周边街道数量。

en: Wellbeing boost for residents within reach.
zh: 为服务范围内居民提供的幸福度加成。

en: Keeps every value inside what vanilla parks of a similar size use.
zh: 将所有数值限制在同等规模原版公园的范围内。

en: How much fun one visit gives a citizen looking for something to do.
zh: 为寻找休闲活动的市民每次到访提供的乐趣。

en: No road edge: only tourism applies.
zh: 无临路边缘：仅旅游属性生效。

en: Only attractiveness reaches the game here. The others are saved with the build.
zh: 此处只有吸引力会在游戏中生效。其他数值会随建造物保存。

en: A small hidden park building at the road edge carries these stats, like a vanilla park.
zh: 路边一座隐藏的小型公园建筑承载这些属性，与原版公园类似。

en: Some values are beyond what vanilla parks this size have; the city may feel unbalanced.
zh: 部分数值超出同等规模原版公园的范围，可能影响城市平衡。

en: How far residents walk to enjoy the park (path cost, about metres).
zh: 居民愿意步行来游园的距离（路径成本，近似米数）。

en: Needs the companion park building (road edge and setting); saved with the build.
zh: 需要配套公园建筑（临路边缘及相关设置）；随建造物保存。

en: Monthly running cost a vanilla park this good would have.
zh: 同等品质原版公园的月度运营费用。

en: Nothing picked yet: pick a category to start
zh: 尚未选择：选择类别以开始

en: Hover to preview, click to use
{0} building(s) in this city are outgrown with “{1}”. They are all outgrown again with its new settings, a few at a time in the background.
zh: 此城市有 {0} 栋建筑采用“{1}”进行庭院扩展。它们都将按新设置重新扩展，后台逐批处理。

en: That is {0} buildings: every garden, yard and car park of theirs is planned and built again. It cannot be undone in one step (save the old settings as a copy first if you may want them back).
zh: 共 {0} 栋建筑：其所有花园、庭院和停车场都将重新规划和建造。无法一步撤销（如可能需要恢复，请先将旧设置另存为副本）。

en: Each building gets the outgrow type its zone type has. Change them in Outgrow (the switcher at the top), or pick any type here to outgrow the area with it.
zh: 每栋建筑采用其分区类型对应的庭院扩展类型。在“庭院扩展”（顶部切换器）中更改，或在此选择任意类型并应用于整个区域。

en: Its colour on the map (the lens's Types) and in the charts.
zh: 地图（类型视图）及图表中的颜色。

en: Buildings outgrown with “{0}” keep how they look until they are outgrown again; zones that used it go back to their own.
zh: 采用“{0}”扩展的建筑会保持现有外观，直至再次扩展；使用此类型的分区将恢复自身默认类型。

en: Pick buildings and outgrow their gardens: shared fences and hedges, lawns or painted ground, planting, by theme.
zh: 选择建筑并扩展其庭院：按主题设置共享围栏和树篱、草坪或涂画地面及植物。

en: On: the buildings in the selection are outgrown again a moment after every change you make, and the selection stays. Remove outgrow puts them back.
zh: 开启：每次更改后稍等片刻，选区内建筑会重新扩展庭院，并保留选区。“移除庭院扩展”可恢复。

en: What is planted and placed in the land: Garden (lawns, beds, a sand pit or a bench), Natural (wild ground, rocks, logs), Tidy (lawns, hedges, flower beds), Yard (worn ground, pallets, rubble). The rows below fine-tune it.
zh: 土地上种植和放置的内容：花园（草坪、花坛、沙坑或长椅）、自然（野生地面、岩石、原木）、整洁（草坪、树篱、花坛）、堆场（磨损地面、托盘、碎石）。下方各项可进一步调整。

en: Every building is outgrown with its zone type's default outgrow type, also the ones you brushed another type onto (zone types set to Off are left out). It runs in the background a few buildings at a time, so the game keeps running smoothly.
zh: 所有建筑均按其分区类型的默认庭院扩展类型处理，包括曾用笔刷应用其他类型的建筑（设置为关闭的分区类型除外）。后台逐批处理少量建筑，确保游戏流畅。
将 {0} 恢复为初始设置

en: Save: this is what {0} is from now on, everywhere it is used
zh: 保存：此后所有使用 {0} 的地方均采用此设置

en: The outgrown buildings go back to how the game made them: fences, hedges and lawns back, the beds, paths, bushes and paving taken away (ground paint stays). It runs in the background a few hundred at a time.
zh: 将已扩展庭院的建筑恢复为游戏原样：恢复围栏、树篱和草坪，移除花坛、步道、灌木和铺装（地面涂画保留）。后台逐批处理数百栋建筑。
基于 {0} 的自定义样式

en: This style can't be saved over
Your style is removed. Builds stay as they are.
zh: 你的样式将被移除。建造物保持原样。

en: Saved. Send this file to share your styles.
zh: 已保存。发送此文件即可分享你的样式。

en: Your changes to this style are dropped.
zh: 将放弃对此样式的更改。

en: Save these settings as a new style
zh: 将这些设置保存为新样式

en: Save over this style (reset any time)
zh: 覆盖保存此样式（可随时重置）

en: See-through game models and textures, exactly what will be built.
zh: 半透明的游戏模型和纹理，与实际建造结果完全一致。

en: Fast outlines and dots. Best while drawing and trying things.
zh: 快速显示轮廓和点。最适合绘制和尝试方案时使用。
生成新的变化。已锁定的值保持不变。

en: Drag to make it taller or shorter. Double-click for full height.
zh: 拖动以增加或减少高度。双击扩展至全高。

en: Drag to make it wider or narrower. Double-click for the default width.
zh: 拖动以增加或减少宽度。双击恢复默认宽度。
确定，我已知晓部分改动为永久性改动

en: Some changes stay after you remove the build (the amber tags). Click it to allow them.
zh: 部分改动在移除建造内容后仍会保留（以琥珀色标签标出）。点击以允许这些改动。

en: warnings and things to look at before building
zh: 建造前需查看的警告和事项

en: Ground paint stays when the build is removed.
zh: 移除建造物后，地面涂画仍保留。

en: Lit when it stops at everything here. Click to turn them all on, or all off when they are all on.
zh: 避开此处所有对象时亮起。点击全部开启；若已全部开启，则全部关闭。

en: A stroke stays in what the Paint bucket would fill where it started.
zh: 一次笔画保持在填充桶从起点可填充的范围内。

en: Keep off what you built with Placemaker.
zh: 避开你使用 Placemaker 建造的对象。

en: Openings narrower than this count as closed, and places narrower than it are left out. 0 = off.
zh: 小于此宽度的开口视为闭合，宽度小于此值的位置会排除。0 = 关闭。

en: Keep off other lots (other mods, extractors).
zh: 避开其他地块（其他模组、开采设施）。

en: How far the fill may spread from where you click. In open land it fills a circle this size.
zh: 填充从点击位置允许扩展的距离。在空地上会填充此大小的圆形区域。

en: Stop at the curb of every road, its junctions and turning circles.
zh: 在所有道路的路缘、交叉口和回车场处停止。

en: On: the brush stops at what you switch on below. Off: it paints over everything.
zh: 开启：笔刷遇到下方已开启的对象类型时会停止。关闭：笔刷会覆盖所有内容。

en: How smooth the painted edge is.
Pulls painted edges this close onto a curb.
zh: 将距离路缘小于此值的涂画边缘吸附至路缘。

en: What the area never covers, for every tool. Red on the map.
zh: 所有工具均不覆盖的对象。在地图上显示为红色。

en: Keep off zoned cells that have a building.
zh: 避开已有建筑的分区网格。

en: Keep off the whole zone grid along the streets, even cells nobody zoned.
zh: 避开街道旁的整个分区网格，包括尚未划分区的网格。

en: How much of the zoning the area keeps off.
Keep off every zoned cell, built on or not.
zh: 避开所有已划分区网格，无论是否已有建筑。

en: Click to fill the land up to what it stops at. Shift+click adds more, right-click drops one.
zh: 点击以填充至停止边界。Shift+点击可添加，右键点击可移除一块。

en: Brush the area on. Right-click erases.
zh: 用笔刷涂画区域。右键擦除。

en: Click corners, then the first one to close. Snaps to curbs, right angles and road nodes: two corners on road nodes follow the road between them.
zh: 点击角点，再点击首个角点闭合。吸附至路缘、直角和道路节点：两个角点位于道路节点时，沿其间道路连接。

en: Restart the game: Placemaker's files were updated while it was running.
zh: 请重启游戏：运行期间 Placemaker 文件已更新。

en: Train and tram tracks on the ground.
zh: 地面铁路和有轨电车轨道。

en: Not available with the current settings
Restart the game to use this: Placemaker was updated while the game was running.
zh: 重启游戏以使用此功能：游戏运行期间 Placemaker 已更新。
当 {0} 为 {1} 时不可用
清除此处此前更改的 {0} 项设置

en: Opens this outgrow type in Outgrow's Edit tab: a change there is for every zone that uses it.
zh: 在庭院扩展的“编辑”标签页打开此类型：此处的更改会应用于所有使用它的分区。
选择特定分区（也包括模组分区）…

en: Its lots, in zone cells (one cell is 8 m), the road along the bottom: the solid block is the smallest lot, the lighter one the biggest; each lot picks a size between. Click or drag near a corner to move it.
zh: 地块以分区网格表示（每格 8 m），道路位于底边：实心方块为最小地块，浅色方块为最大地块；每个地块在两者之间选取尺寸。点击或拖动角点附近可移动。

en: Nothing is zoned: the buildings in the area outgrow their lots, each zone type by its own settings (a type not listed: the first one's).
zh: 不划定任何分区：区域内建筑按各自分区类型的设置扩展地块（未列出的类型采用第一项设置）。

en: The empty zone cells of the area get these zones, as lots that start at the road; the buildings there outgrow their lots too.
zh: 区域内的空白分区网格将按这些分区划成从道路起始的地块；已有建筑也会扩展地块。

en: No zoned buildings in the selection: pick an area with buildings.
zh: 选区内没有分区建筑：请选择有建筑的区域。

en: On: this zone's buildings outgrow their lots with the outgrow type beside it. Off: they stay as the game makes them.
zh: 开启：此分区的建筑使用旁边的庭院扩展类型扩展地块。关闭：保持游戏原样。

en: Allowed road width: the roads this zone may line, by their width (two lanes 16 m, four lanes 24 m, six lanes 32 m). Its lots are only placed along roads in this range.
zh: 允许的道路宽度：此分区可沿哪些宽度的道路布置（双车道 16 m、四车道 24 m、六车道 32 m）。地块仅沿此范围内的道路放置。

en: zones, and how their lots outgrow
zh: 分区及其地块扩展方式

en: Intensive city growing: market garden beds, vineyard rows, glasshouses, lavender or raised beds, with tracks, a farmyard and hedges.
zh: 城市集约种植：蔬菜田、葡萄藤行列、温室、薰衣草或高架种植床，配有农道、农家院和树篱。

en: No room for fields: the area is too narrow for the field size.
zh: 没有空间容纳农田：区域过窄，无法适应田块尺寸。

en: What grows in the fields. Mixed gives neighbouring fields different crops.
zh: 田中种植的作物。混合模式使相邻田块种植不同作物。

en: Rows along the long side of the plot, across it, or diagonally.
zh: 种植行沿地块长边、横向或斜向排列。

en: Closer rows and plants above 100 %, wider below. Very large farms widen the spacing to stay within the object budget.
zh: 高于 100 % 时行距和株距更密，低于时更疏。超大型农场会增大间距，以不超出对象数量预算。

en: Market garden: every third field becomes a range of glasshouses.
zh: 蔬菜园：每三个田块中有一个变为温室群。

en: Length of a field between cross tracks; fields are about 60 % as wide.
zh: 横向农道之间的田块长度；宽度约为其 60 %。

en: Spine: one long track with cross tracks. Grid: tracks round every field. Loop: a track round the inside of the edge. None: grass headlands only.
zh: 主轴：一条纵向农道配横向农道。网格：每个田块周围都有农道。环路：沿边缘内侧设置农道。无：仅保留草地田头。

en: A gravel yard by the entrance with a barn, water tanks, crates and machinery.
zh: 入口旁的砂砾农家院，配有谷仓、水箱、板条箱和机械。

en: A produce stand at the yard's entrance end.
zh: 农家院靠入口一端的农产品摊位。

en: A row of trees just inside the edge, with gaps at the entrances.
zh: 紧邻边缘内侧的一排树，入口处留有缺口。

en: Terraces for vines on a slope, a level pad for glasshouses, or gentle swells. Always blended back to the original ground at the edge. Permanent.
zh: 坡地葡萄园使用台地，温室使用平整平台，或塑造缓和起伏。始终在边缘平滑接回原地形。永久更改。

en: Paints the terrain texture under the crop fields. Permanent.
zh: 在作物田下方涂画地形纹理。永久更改。

en: Benches beside the tracks every so many metres; 0 = none.
zh: 沿农道每隔指定米数设置长椅；0 = 无。

en: Scarecrows per hectare, in the middle of the largest crop fields.
zh: 每公顷的稻草人数量，放置在最大作物田的中央。

en: A water tank at the track corner of each large field and by the glasshouses.
zh: 在每个大田块的农道转角处和温室旁放置水箱。

en: Hives in short rows facing the middle, or in a circle facing out.
zh: 蜂箱成短排面向中间，或围成圆圈面朝外。

en: A small fence round the bee yard with a gate towards the middle.
zh: 蜂场周围的小围栏，门朝向中间。

en: Flower beds round the back of the bee yard.
Crates of produce either side of the stall.
A skate spot among the ruins of a broken-down highway: pillars, fallen deck, DIY ramps, graffiti and dirt jumps.
zh: 废弃公路遗迹中的滑板场地：桥柱、坍塌桥面、自制坡道、涂鸦和土坡跳台。

en: What the ruins became. Each type lays the spot out differently.
zh: 废墟改造后的用途。各类型采用不同布局。

en: Ramps, rails and boxes in lines on the pads under the highway; ramps at the ends face in.
zh: 在公路下方的平台上成线布置坡道、栏杆和箱体；两端坡道朝内。

en: Graffiti on pillars, walls, blocks and along the pads.
zh: 桥柱、墙面、方块和平台沿线的涂鸦。

en: How ruined it is: rubble on the fallen spans, cracks, faded markings.
zh: 破败程度：坍塌跨段上的碎石、裂纹和褪色标线。

en: Wild plants reclaiming the edges and the fallen deck.
zh: 重新占据边缘和坍塌桥面的野生植物。

en: The old highway line: pillar pairs, spans that stand or have fallen.
zh: 旧公路线位：成对桥柱、仍直立或已坍塌的跨段。

en: Through the middle, or along one side leaving a big yard.
zh: 穿过中间，或沿一侧布置以留出大场地。

en: Share of spans that fell: broken asphalt, tilted slabs and rubble on the ground, stumps for pillars.
zh: 已坍塌跨段的比例：地面上破碎的沥青、倾斜板块和碎石，以及残断桥柱。

en: An earth on-ramp rising towards a broken-off end (permanent terraform).
zh: 朝断裂端抬升的土质入口匝道（永久改变地形）。

en: Faded lane markings on the fallen carriageway.
zh: 坍塌车行道上的褪色车道标线。

en: Concrete pads under the standing spans where the skaters built their spot.
zh: 直立跨段下方供滑板玩家搭建场地的混凝土平台。

en: Concrete blocks and barriers dragged onto the pads as ledges.
zh: 拖到平台上作为滑台的混凝土块和护栏。

en: A dug bowl in a pad (permanent terraform). 0 = none.
zh: 在平台上挖出的碗池（永久改变地形）。0 = 无。

en: BMX dirt-jump lines (take-off and landing mounds) in the yard.
zh: 场地内的 BMX 土坡跳跃线路（起跳丘和落地丘）。
一组起跳／落地坡的长度。

en: A field of concrete blocks of different sizes on gravel.
zh: 砂砾地上大小不同的混凝土块群。

en: Free-standing legal walls in a zig-zag row, painted on both sides.
zh: 之字形成排布置的独立合法涂鸦墙，两面均涂画。

en: Share of fence panels that are missing.
The area is too narrow for the highway line.
zh: 区域过窄，无法容纳公路线位。

en: Only {0} of {1} fit in the yard.
Height of the take-off mounds (permanent terraform).
zh: 起跳丘高度（永久改变地形）。

en: Take-off/landing pairs per line (fewer when they do not fit).
zh: 每条线路的起跳／落地坡组数（无法容纳时会减少）。

en: A taller hill at the start of each line to build speed.
zh: 每条线路起点用于加速的较高土坡。

en: No free ground was big enough for the dirt jumps.
zh: 没有足够大的空地容纳土坡跳台。

en: A designed edge to the water, fitted to the terrain: a quay, walkway quay, boardwalk or natural bank at the water, a smooth embankment up to one level promenade with benches facing the water, lamps, planted beds and trees, piers from landings, step flights down to the river. Cliffs stay natural, with a cliff-top walk.
zh: 顺应地形设计的水岸：临水处设置码头岸、步行码头岸、木栈道或自然岸坡，以平滑堤坡连接到同一高度的滨水步道，配有朝水长椅、路灯、花坛和树木，从平台伸出的栈桥，以及通向河边的台阶。悬崖保持自然，并设崖顶步道。

en: Promenade boardwalk, pier park, harbour quay, river steps or natural bank: each sets the water edge, the promenade and the planting.
zh: 滨水木栈道、栈桥公园、港口码头岸、河岸台阶或自然岸坡：各自设定水岸、滨水步道和种植方式。

en: Distance from the water to the promenade (on a harbour quay: the depth of the paved apron behind the quay).
zh: 水面至滨水步道的距离（港口码头岸：码头后方铺装平台的深度）。

en: One continuous railing along the promenade's water edge, only where the ground there drops more than 1 m (quays and piers bring their own).
zh: 沿滨水步道临水边缘设置连续栏杆，仅用于此处地面落差超过 1 m 的位置（码头岸和栈桥自带栏杆）。

en: Lamps along the water side of the walk. 0 = none.
zh: 步道临水一侧的路灯。0 = 无。
面朝水面的长椅。0 = 无。

en: Bollards along the quay edge, as in a harbor.
zh: 沿码头边缘设置的系缆柱，呈现港口景观。

en: Rocks along the waterline (riprap), for a natural bank.
zh: 沿水线布置的岩石（护岸块石），用于自然岸坡。

en: Paved flights on the smooth bank from the promenade down to the walkway quay: a few spots, or regularly along the whole edge.
zh: 沿平滑岸坡从滨水步道通向步行码头岸的铺装台阶：设置于少数位置，或沿整段岸边规律分布。

en: Unused since s30: the flights lie on the smooth bank (no terraces).
zh: 自 s30 起不再使用：台阶位于平滑岸坡上（不设台地）。

en: Piers built as paths out over the water. They reach past the outline over the water when the area is drawn along the shore.
zh: 以步道形式伸入水面的栈桥。区域沿岸绘制时，栈桥会越过轮廓伸向水面。

en: A cross walk at the end of each pier.
zh: 每座栈桥尽头的横向步道。

en: Spots along the edge with fishing props, a seat and a bin.
zh: 沿岸设置垂钓道具、座椅和垃圾桶的点位。

en: Life rings by the edge, anchors, buoys and crates along the walk.
zh: 岸边的救生圈，以及步道沿线的船锚、浮标和板条箱。

en: A tree row, or a double row (avenue), behind the promenade.
zh: 滨水步道后方的一排或双排树木（林荫大道）。

en: What fills the land behind the promenade: a lawn, a planted park, or nothing.
zh: 滨水步道后方的填充内容：草坪、绿化公园或留空。

en: Paint a soft sand or dirt band into the terrain at the water’s edge (permanent). Automatic: sand for promenades and piers, dirt for fishing banks, none for quays.
zh: 在水边地形上涂画柔和的沙地或泥土带（永久更改）。自动：滨水步道和栈桥使用沙地，垂钓岸坡使用泥土，码头岸不使用。

en: Piers need water beside or inside the area: draw it along the shore or out over the water.
zh: 栈桥需要区域旁或区域内有水面：请沿岸或向水面绘制区域。

en: What meets the water: a wide quay (stone wall, deck above the water), a walkway quay, a timber boardwalk just off the bank, or a natural bank graded into the water. Automatic picks by type.
zh: 与水面相接的形式：宽码头岸（石墙，平台高于水面）、步行码头岸、略离岸边的木栈道，或平缓伸入水中的自然岸坡。自动模式按类型选择。

en: Height of the quay or boardwalk deck above the water. The land behind a quay is filled to this level (permanent).
zh: 码头岸或木栈道平台高出水面的高度。码头岸后方土地会填至此高度（永久更改）。

en: Beds of low flowering shrubs in the bays behind the promenade.
zh: 滨水步道后方凹入空间内的低矮开花灌木花坛。

en: Where the level promenade is cut into rising ground: a retaining wall along its land edge (as when a road is built into a slope), a graded grass bank back up to the ground, or automatic (a wall when the cut is between 1.5 m and the wall height limit, else a bank).
zh: 水平滨水步道切入升高地形时的处理方式：沿陆侧边缘设置挡土墙（类似道路切入坡地）、以平缓草坡接回原地面，或自动（挖深介于 1.5 m 与墙高上限之间时用墙，否则用坡）。

en: Highest retaining wall allowed along the promenade's land side; a taller cut gets a graded bank instead.
zh: 滨水步道陆侧允许的最高挡土墙；更高的挖方改用平缓边坡。

en: The hillside behind the promenade rises {0} m, above the {1} m wall limit: graded as a bank instead.
zh: 滨水步道后方山坡高出 {0} m，超过 {1} m 的墙高上限：改为平整边坡。

en: Shallow ponds with boardwalks, islands, reed beds and bird hides.
zh: 浅水池塘，配有木栈道、岛屿、芦苇丛和观鸟隐蔽屋。

en: How the wetland is composed: ponds and trails, a water garden, a reed marsh, rain-garden swales or a bird reserve.
zh: 湿地组成：池塘与小径、水景花园、芦苇沼泽、雨水花园洼沟或鸟类保护区。

en: Share of the area that becomes open water. Ponds only grow where the trails leave room.
zh: 区域中开阔水面的比例。池塘只会在小径留出的空间内扩展。

en: How many separate ponds the water is split into.
zh: 水面分割成的独立池塘数量。

en: Depth of the open water below the water level. Wetlands are shallow: around 1 m.
zh: 开阔水面在水位以下的深度。湿地水较浅：约 1 m。

en: Wild islands left in the larger ponds, with a channel all round, for nesting birds.
zh: 在较大池塘中保留的自然岛屿，四周有水道，供鸟类筑巢。

en: A shallow shelf along the shore where reeds stand in the water, before the deeper middle.
zh: 沿岸设置的浅水台地，使芦苇生长在水中，再向中央深水过渡。

en: Walks across the water from trail to trail, or out to a platform. The ground under them stays dry.
zh: 从一条小径跨水通向另一条，或伸向观景平台的步道。其下方地面保持干燥。

en: Long boardwalks zig-zag over the water instead of running straight.
zh: 较长木栈道在水面上曲折延伸，而非笔直穿过。

en: A small paved terrace on the bank with benches facing the water.
zh: 岸边的小型铺装平台，配有面朝水面的长椅。

en: Path used across the water; pick a wooden path for a real boardwalk look.
zh: 跨水步道使用的资产；选择木质步道可呈现真实木栈道效果。

en: How densely reeds are massed along the shores, in clumps.
zh: 沿岸成丛种植芦苇的密度。

en: How far up the bank the reed beds reach.
zh: 芦苇丛向岸上延伸的距离。

en: A belt of trees along the outline that screens the water from the street.
zh: 沿轮廓种植的树带，遮挡街道看向水面的视线。

en: Hides on the bank facing the islands, or at the end of a boardwalk spur.
zh: 位于岸边面朝岛屿，或位于木栈道支线末端的隐蔽屋。

en: A lookout beside a trail with the best view over the water.
zh: 小径旁、水景视野最佳位置的瞭望点。

en: Adds animal spawners on dry ground.
zh: 在干地上添加动物生成点。

en: Paints the banks around the water with a terrain texture (permanent).
zh: 用地形纹理涂画水域周围的岸边（永久更改）。

en: Which of the map's extra terrain textures (1–4) the banks get.
zh: 岸边采用地图的哪一种额外地形纹理（1–4）。

en: Height of gentle mounds on dry ground away from the water (0 = flat). Blended to the original ground at the outline.
zh: 远离水面的干地上缓坡土丘的高度（0 = 平地）。在轮廓处平滑接回原地形。

en: The ponds are dug into the terrain and filled with water. This is permanent: removing the wetland does not restore the ground.
zh: 池塘会在地形中挖出并注水。这是永久更改：移除湿地不会恢复地面。

en: No room for ponds between the trails. Make the area larger or use fewer entrances.
zh: 小径之间没有空间容纳池塘。请扩大区域或减少入口。

en: Only {0} of {1} ponds fit between the trails.
zh: 小径之间仅能容纳 {0}/{1} 个池塘。

en: Only {0} of {1} bird hides found a spot on the banks.
zh: 仅 {0}/{1} 个观鸟隐蔽屋能在岸边找到位置。

en: Quiet corners that get nest boxes, a log and stone pile and wildlife.
zh: 配有巢箱、原木和石堆以及野生动物的安静角落。

en: How far from any path a habitat corner must be.
zh: 栖息地角落与任何步道之间必须保持的距离。

en: Bird or bat boxes and insect hotels.
zh: 鸟类或蝙蝠巢箱，以及昆虫旅馆。

en: A few small stones piled for insects and amphibians.
zh: 供昆虫和两栖动物栖息的小石堆。

en: Raked gravel, rock groupings, a pond with bridges, lanterns and stepping stones.
zh: 耙纹砂砾、组合岩石、带桥池塘、石灯笼和汀步。

en: Dry rock garden, pond stroll garden, tea garden, moss garden or bamboo grove.
zh: 枯山水庭园、池泉回游庭园、茶庭、苔藓庭园或竹林。

en: Share of the inner garden given to the raked gravel field (0 = none).
zh: 内部庭园中分配给耙纹砂砾庭院的比例（0 = 无）。

en: A pond in the inner garden with bridges and islands. Digging it is permanent.
zh: 内部庭园中的池塘，配有桥梁和岛屿。挖掘为永久更改。

en: A crisp rectangle (temple garden) or a soft organic outline.
zh: 轮廓清晰的矩形（寺院庭园），或柔和的自然形轮廓。

en: Raked patterns painted into the gravel: straight lines, ripples around the rocks, or both.
zh: 在砂砾中涂画耙纹图案：直线、围绕岩石的波纹，或两者兼有。

en: Which of the map's extra terrain textures (1–4) the gravel field gets (permanent paint).
zh: 砂砾庭院采用地图的哪一种额外地形纹理（1–4）（永久涂画）。

en: Texture (1–4) of the raked strokes; pick one that contrasts with the gravel.
zh: 耙纹笔画的纹理（1–4）；请选择与砂砾形成对比的纹理。

en: Lay a gravel or sand surface instead of painting the terrain (no raking then).
zh: 铺设砂砾或沙地表面代替地形涂画（此时无耙纹）。

en: Number of rock groupings — always odd, never symmetric.
zh: 岩石组合数量——始终为奇数，且不对称。

en: Stones in each group: threes, fives, or the classic mixed 5-3-3-1-3 rhythm.
zh: 每组石头数量：三块、五块，或经典的 5-3-3-1-3 混合节奏。

en: Moss painted under the rock groups in the gravel.
zh: 在砂砾中的石组下方涂画苔藓。

en: Share of the area the pond aims for.
Zig-zag plank bridges (yatsuhashi) or straight crossings.
zh: 之字形木板桥（八桥），或直桥。

en: Crane and turtle islands, each with a pine.
zh: 鹤岛与龟岛，各种一棵松树。

en: Stepping-stone trails through the moss and to the tea house.
zh: 穿过苔藓并通向茶室的汀步小径。

en: Specimen pines, maples and cherries per hectare.
zh: 每公顷的观赏松树、枫树和樱树数量。

en: Clipped shrub mounds per hectare, set in groups of three or five.
zh: 每公顷的修剪灌木丘数量，按三株或五株成组布置。

en: A bamboo screen along the outline, or a whole bamboo grove.
zh: 沿轮廓的竹屏障，或整片竹林。

en: Paints the inner garden with a terrain texture (permanent).
zh: 用地形纹理涂画内部庭园（永久更改）。

en: Lanterns at bridge ends, entrances, the shore and the rock groups.
zh: 桥头、入口、岸边和石组旁的灯笼。

en: A tea house on the quietest spot, with a waiting bench, basin and stepping stones.
zh: 位于最安静处的茶室，配有等候长椅、水钵和汀步。

en: A stone water basin (tsukubai) with a lantern beside it.
zh: 旁有灯笼的石制水钵（蹲踞）。

en: A wall or fence around the garden, open at the entrances.
zh: 环绕庭园的墙或围栏，入口处留开口。

en: The pond is dug into the terrain and filled with water. This is permanent: removing the garden does not restore the ground.
zh: 池塘会在地形中挖出并注水。这是永久更改：移除庭园不会恢复地面。

en: The gravel field did not fit in the inner garden. Lower the gravel share or enlarge the area.
zh: 内部庭园无法容纳砂砾庭院。请降低砂砾比例或扩大区域。

en: No room for the pond inside the stroll loop.
zh: 回游环路内没有空间容纳池塘。

en: No quiet spot was large enough for the tea house.
zh: 没有足够大的安静位置放置茶室。

en: Only {0} of {1} rock groups found a place.
zh: 仅 {0}/{1} 组岩石找到位置。

en: A bench on the way in, where guests wait to be called.
zh: 入口途中供客人等候招呼的长椅。

en: A stone basin by the entrance for washing hands.
zh: 入口旁供洗手的石制水钵。

en: Stepping stones from the nearest path to the door.
zh: 从最近步道通向门口的汀步。
